exercises.explanationUz:
UNIT NOMI: 'All's Well that Ends Well'
  = Oxiri yaxshi bo'lsa, hammasi yaxshi.
  Bu — Shekspir pyesasining nomi, ingliz maqoliga aylangan.
  Ma'nosi: qiyinchiliklar bo'lsa ham, natija yaxshi bo'lsa,
  hammasi joyida.

OLTI RASM — HIKOYA KETMA-KETLIGI:

  A  Safari parkda mashina sherlar orasida qolgan.
     Sherlar mashinani o'rab olgan, qo'rqinchli ko'rinadi.

  B  Mashina ichida. Dvigateldan TUTUN chiqyapti.
     Ikkalasi ham xavotirda.

  C  Mashinaning oldi YONYAPTI. Ikkalasi dahshatda.

  D  Mashina yonmoqda, yonida boshqa avtomobil,
     sherlar hali ham atrofda.

  E  Odamlar yonayotgan mashinadan 'Safari Park'
     yozuvli jipga yugurib ketishyapti.

  F  Er-xotin quchoqlashgan — qutulishdi, xursand.

QAHRAMONLAR:
  CLAIRE (Kler) — sariq sochli ayol
  GREG (Greg)   — sariq sochli erkak
  PARK RANGER   — parkni qo'riqlovchi xodim

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a safari park = safari park (hayvonlar erkin yuradigan bog')
  a park ranger = park qo'riqchisi, bog' xodimi
  an engine     = dvigatel
  smoke         = tutun
  on fire       = yonayotgan
  scary         = qo'rqinchli
  a jeep        = jip

tasks.prompt: 1  Where are the two people in picture A?
tasks.whyUz:
A-rasmda SHERLAR erkin yuribdi → SAFARI PARK.
'an aquarium' = akvarium (baliqlar uchun) — mos emas.
Hikoyada joy nomi ham bor: Longleat Safari Park.

tasks.prompt: 2  How do the lions look in picture A?
tasks.whyUz:
Sherlar mashinani o'rab olgan, tishlari ko'rinadi →
QO'RQINChLI.
'scary' = qo'rqinchli;  'friendly' = do'stona.
77-betdagi matnda ham: 'very SCARY animals'.

tasks.prompt: 3  What is coming out of the engine in picture B?
tasks.whyUz:
B-rasmda dvigateldan kulrang TUTUN chiqyapti — hali olov emas.
Olov keyingi rasmda (C) paydo bo'ladi.
77-betdagi matnda: 'SMOKE began to come out of the engine'.

tasks.prompt: 4  What's wrong with the front of the car in picture C?
options: b There's a lion on it.
tasks.whyUz:
C-rasmda mashinaning oldi YONYAPTI.
77-betdagi matnda: 'the front of the car was ON FIRE'.
'What's wrong with ...?' = ...da nima yomon?

tasks.prompt: 5  What does a park ranger do?
tasks.answer: a He looks after a park.
options: a He looks after a park.
tasks.whyUz:
'a park ranger' = bog'ni QO'RIQLAYDIGAN va PARVARISH
qiladigan xodim.
'look after' = qaramoq, parvarish qilmoq.
'put out fires' = o't o'chirmoq — bu o't o'chiruvchining ishi
('a firefighter').

tasks.prompt: 6  How do the people feel in picture C?
tasks.whyUz:
Mashina yonyapti, chiqib bo'lmaydi → QO'RQQAN.
'scared' = qo'rqqan.
77-betdagi matnda: 'They were both really SCARED'.

tasks.prompt: 7  How do they feel in picture F?
tasks.whyUz:
F-rasmda quchoqlashgan va jilmayishyapti — qutulishdi.
Lekin hali sarosimadalar.
77-betdagi matnda: 'They were still SHOCKED, but HAPPY'.
Unit nomiga mos: 'All's Well that Ends Well'.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the list of events below. Then, listen to the sounds and number the events in the order you hear them in the boxes provided.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi voqealar ro'yxatini o'rganing. So'ng tovushlarni tinglang va voqealarni eshitgan tartibingizda raqamlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu mashqda TOVUSHLAR tinglanadi:
  kulgi, fotoapparat, sher bo'kirishi, dvigatel ovozi,
  signal va qichqiriq, jip ovozi, yugurish qadamlari.

TARTIB 77-BETDAGI HIKOYADA ANIQ YOZILGAN —
shuning uchun bu yerda to'liq berildi.

TO'G'RI TARTIB:

  1  Claire laughed.                           (KITOBDA berilgan)
  2  He stopped the car and started taking
     pictures of the lions.
  3  The lions roared loudly.
  4  He tried to start the car several times.
  5  She beeped the horn and shouted for help.
  6  Just then, a park ranger came along the
     road in his jeep.
  7  They jumped out of the car quickly and
     ran to the jeep.

HIKOYADAGI KETMA-KETLIK (77-bet):
  '... Claire LAUGHED. Soon, they saw some lions.
   Greg STOPPED the car ... and started TAKING PICTURES.
   The lions ROARED loudly. ...
   He TRIED TO START the car several times ...
   She BEEPED THE HORN and shouted for help.
   Just then, a park ranger CAME ALONG the road in his jeep.
   ... Claire and Greg JUMPED OUT of the car quickly and
   RAN TOWARDS the jeep.'

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to roar      = bo'kirmoq (sher haqida)
  to beep the horn = signal chalmoq
  a horn       = signal (mashinada)
  to jump out of = ...dan sakrab chiqmoq
  along        = bo'ylab
  just then    = shu payt

tasks.prompt: He stopped the car and started taking pictures of the lions.
tasks.whyUz:
IKKINCHI voqea.
Matnda: 'Greg STOPPED the car very close to the lions and
STARTED TAKING PICTURES of them.'
A-rasmga mos keladi.
tasks.speak: He stopped the car and started taking pictures of the lions.

tasks.whyUz:
UCHINCHI voqea.
Matnda: 'The lions ROARED loudly.'
'to roar' = bo'kirmoq.

tasks.prompt: He tried to start the car several times.
tasks.whyUz:
TO'RTINCHI voqea.
Matnda: 'He TRIED TO START the car several times, but
nothing happened.'
Mashina yurmadi — muammo shu yerdan boshlandi.
'several times' = bir necha marta.
tasks.speak: He tried to start the car several times.

tasks.prompt: She beeped the horn and shouted for help.
tasks.whyUz:
BESHINCHI voqea.
Matnda: 'She BEEPED THE HORN and SHOUTED FOR HELP.'
C-rasmga mos keladi.
'shout FOR help' = yordam so'rab qichqirmoq.
tasks.speak: She beeped the horn and shouted for help.

tasks.prompt: Just then, a park ranger came along the road in his jeep.
tasks.whyUz:
OLTINCHI voqea.
Matnda: 'JUST THEN, a park ranger CAME ALONG the road in
his jeep.'
'just then' = shu payt (kutilmaganda).
tasks.speak: Just then, a park ranger came along the road in his jeep.

tasks.prompt: They jumped out of the car quickly and ran to the jeep.
tasks.whyUz:
YETTINChI voqea.
Matnda: 'Claire and Greg JUMPED OUT of the car quickly and
RAN TOWARDS the jeep.'
E-rasmga mos keladi.
DIQQAT: matnda 'ran TOWARDS', mashqda 'ran TO' —
ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.
tasks.speak: They jumped out of the car quickly and ran to the jeep.

exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni o'qing, so'ng hikoyani tinglab kim nima aytganini yozing. Kler uchun C, Greg uchun G, park qo'riqchisi uchun P deb yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCH QAHRAMON:
  C = CLAIRE (Kler) — ayol
  G = GREG (Greg) — erkak
  P = PARK RANGER (park qo'riqchisi)

Javoblar 77-betdagi hikoya matnida ANIQ yozilgan —
har bir gapdan keyin kim aytgani ko'rsatilgan.

USUL — ISM CHAQIRILSA, BOSHQASI AYTADI:
  "You're right, CLAIRE ..." → GREG aytdi

MANTIQ ham yordam beradi:
  Qutqaruvchi gap ('we'll get you out') → RANGER
  Qo'rquv gaplari → CLAIRE (u ko'proq qo'rqadi)

tasks.prompt: a  "We don't want to be a lion's lunch."
tasks.whyUz:
CLAIRE.
Matnda: "'We don't want to be a lion's lunch,'
CLAIRE LAUGHED."
2-mashqning 1-bandi ham shu gapga asoslanadi.
"a lion's LUNCH" = sherning tushligi — hazil.
'lion'S' — egalik apostrofi.

tasks.prompt: b  "They're beautiful, but very scary animals."
tasks.whyUz:
CLAIRE.
Matnda: "'They're beautiful, but very scary animals,'
CLAIRE SAID."
Keyingi gapda Greg 'You're right, CLAIRE' deydi —
bu ham tasdiqlaydi.

tasks.prompt: c  "Let's go and see the gorillas, now."
tasks.whyUz:
GREG.
Matnda: "'You're right, Claire. Let's go and see the
gorillas, now,' GREG SAID."
DIQQAT: gapda 'Claire' CHAQIRILGAN → demak BOShQASI
(Greg) aytdi.
'a gorilla' = gorilla.

CLAIRE.
Matnda: "'We'll burn alive!' CLAIRE SCREAMED desperately."
'to burn alive' = tiriklayin yonmoq.
'desperately' = umidsizlik bilan, jon holatda.
'we'll' = we WILL — kelasi zamon bashorati (69-betdagi qoida).

tasks.prompt: e  "Hold on, we'll get you out!"
tasks.whyUz:
PARK RANGER.
Matnda: "'Hold on, we'll get you out!' HE SHOUTED" —
'he' = oldingi gapda aytilgan park ranger.
'Hold on!' = chidang! kuting!
'get somebody out' = kimnidir chiqarib olmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Write the past simple tense of these verbs.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu fe'llarning oddiy o'tgan zamon shaklini yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N IKKI FE'L — hammasi hikoyada uchraydi.

TO'G'RI FE'LLAR (5 ta):
  close → closed    (oxiri -E → + D)
  stop  → stopped   (undosh IKKILANADI)
  chase → chased    (oxiri -E → + D)
  start → started   (oddiy + ED)
  roar  → roared    (oddiy + ED)
  try   → tried     (undosh + Y → IED)
  jump  → jumped    (oddiy + ED)

NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR (5 ta):
  go    → went
  come  → came
  see   → saw
  know  → knew
  begin → began

DIQQAT — 'STOP' va 'TRY':
  stop → stoPPed  (bir bo'g'inli, urg'uli unli → P ikkilanadi)
  try  → trIED    ('r' undosh + 'y' → -IED)

tasks.whyUz:
go → WENT.
Matnda: 'Claire and Greg WENT to Longleat Safari Park'.

close → closed (to'g'ri fe'l).
Matnda: 'they CLOSED the car windows tightly'.

come → CAME.
Matnda: 'a park ranger CAME along the road'.
'become → became' bilan bir xil naqsh.

see → SAW, o'qilishi /sɔː/.
Matnda: 'they SAW some lions'.
DIQQAT: 'seed' XATO.

stop → stoPPed.
Bir bo'g'inli, oxiri UNDOSH+UNLI+UNDOSH → 'p' ikkilanadi.
Matnda: 'Greg STOPPED the car'.

chase → chased (to'g'ri fe'l).
Matnda: 'another jeep arrived and CHASED AWAY the lions'.

start → started.
-ed /ɪd/ deb o'qiladi (oxiri 't').
Matnda: 'STARTED taking pictures'.

roar → roared.
Matnda: 'The lions ROARED loudly'.

know → KNEW.
DIQQAT: boshidagi 'k' O'QILMAYDI — /njuː/.
Matnda: 'They KNEW they were very lucky'.

try → TRIED ('r' undosh + 'y' → -IED).
Matnda: 'He TRIED to start the car'.

begin → BEGAN.
Matnda: 'smoke BEGAN to come out of the engine'.
'sing → sang' bilan bir xil naqsh.

jump → jumped.
Matnda: 'Claire and Greg JUMPED OUT of the car'.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the list to fill in the gaps, then use them to make sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring, so'ng ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (9 ta so'z, 9 ta bo'shliq):
  beeped, burn, roared, tightly, park, lucky, chased,
  screamed, scary

Har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.
Barcha iboralar 77-betdagi hikoyadan olingan.

QANDAY TANLANADI:
  bo'shliqdan KEYIN ot bo'lsa → SIFAT yoki aniqlovchi
     ...... ranger  → park
     ...... animals → scary
  bo'shliqdan KEYIN ravish bo'lsa → FE'L
     ...... loudly     → roared
     ...... desperately → screamed

tasks.whyUz:
'closed the windows TIGHTLY' = oynalarni mahkam yopdi.
'tight' (mahkam) + -ly → RAVISH.
Gap: When they drove into the park, they closed the car
windows tightly.

'ROARED loudly' = baland ovozda bo'kirdi.
'loudly' — ravish, fe'lga tegishli.
Gap: The lions roared loudly.

'BEEPED the horn' = signal chaldi.
Gap: She beeped the horn and shouted for help.

'SCREAMED desperately' = jon holatda qichqirdi.
'to scream' = chinqirmoq (qo'rquvdan).
Gap: "We'll burn alive!" Claire screamed desperately.

'BURN alive' = tiriklayin yonmoq.
DIQQAT: bu yerda fe'l ASOSIY shaklda —
chunki 'we'll' dan keyin keladi.
Gap: We'll burn alive!

'PARK ranger' = park qo'riqchisi.
'park' bu yerda OT sifatida boshqa otni aniqlaydi
(qo'shma ot).
Gap: A park ranger came along the road in his jeep.

'SCARY animals' = qo'rqinchli hayvonlar.
DIQQAT: 'scary' (narsa qo'rqinchli) ↔ 'scared' (odam qo'rqqan).
Gap: They're beautiful, but very scary animals.

'CHASED AWAY the lions' = sherlarni quvib yubordi.
'chase away' — frazali fe'l.
Gap: Another jeep arrived and chased away the lions.

tasks.promptUz: Tirik qolganlari uchun qanday his qilishdi?
tasks.whyUz:
'LUCKY to be alive' = tirik qolgani uchun omadli.
'lucky' = omadli;  'luck' = omad.
Gap: They knew they were very lucky to be alive.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct prepositions from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan to'g'ri predloglarni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: around, towards, on, in, into, out of, for, along

8 ta predlog, 9 ta bo'shliq — demak bittasi
IKKI MARTA ishlatiladi:
  'for' → 2 marta (shouted FOR help, thanked him FOR his help)

Hamma ibora 77-betdagi hikoyadan olingan.

ENG MUHIM JUFTLIK — 'IN' va 'INTO':
  INTO — HARAKAT, ichkariga kirish
     they drove INTO the park  (tashqaridan ichkariga)
  IN   — JOY, ichida bo'lish
     he came in his jeep       (jip ichida edi)

ENG MUHIM JUFTLIK — 'TO' va 'TOWARDS':
  TO      — maqsad, yetib borish
  TOWARDS — YO'NALISh, ...tomon
     they ran TOWARDS the jeep  (jip tomon)

tasks.whyUz:
'drove INTO the park' = parkka haydab kirdi.
INTO — ichkariga HARAKAT.
DIQQAT: 'in the park' bo'lsa — parkning ICHIDA bo'lish
(harakat emas).

'ON fire' = yonayotgan — o'zgarmas ibora.
'in fire' XATO.

'jump OUT OF the car' = mashinadan sakrab chiqmoq.
IKKI so'zdan iborat predlog.
'INTO' ning aksi:
  jump INTO the car   (ichkariga)
  jump OUT OF the car (tashqariga)

'AROUND it' = uning atrofida.
Shuning uchun chiqib bo'lmasdi.

'shout FOR help' = yordam so'rab qichqirmoq.
'for' — MAQSAD bildiradi.
8-band bilan solishtiring — 'for' u yerda ham bor.

tasks.prompt: 6  he came ............ the road ............ his jeep  [1-bo'shliq]
tasks.whyUz:
'come ALONG the road' = yo'l bo'ylab kelmoq.
'along' = bo'ylab (uzunasiga).
tasks.speak: 6  he came ............ the road ............ his jeep  [1-bo'shliq]

tasks.whyUz:
'IN his jeep' = jipida (ichida o'tirgan).
DIQQAT — TRANSPORT PREDLOGLARI:
  BY car/jeep  — umumiy usul ('by jeep')
  IN a car/jeep — aniq mashina ichida
  ON a bus/train — katta transportda

'run TOWARDS the jeep' = jip tomon yugurmoq.
'towards' = ...tomon (YO'NALISh).
DIQQAT: 'to' ham to'g'ri, lekin 'towards' harakat
yo'nalishini kuchliroq ta'kidlaydi.

'thank somebody FOR something' = ...uchun rahmat aytmoq.
'for' SHART.
5-band bilan bir xil predlog — ro'yxatda 8 ta so'z,
9 ta bo'shliq bo'lgani uchun 'for' ikki marta.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the adjectives from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi sifatlarni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (5 ta sifat, 5 ta bo'shliq):
  beautiful, sunny, shocking, white, happy

Har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.

TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Everything was ready for Sally's wedding that SUNNY day.
  She put on her WHITE silk dress and went downstairs. Just
  then, a BEAUTIFUL bouquet of flowers arrived for her.
  Sally had a HAPPY smile on her face. "From David," she
  thought. Suddenly, she screamed as she read the SHOCKING
  message on the bouquet.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  O'sha quyoshli kuni Sallining to'yi uchun hammasi tayyor
  edi. U oq ipak ko'ylagini kiydi va pastga tushdi. Shu
  payt unga go'zal gul dastasi keldi. Sallining yuzida
  baxtli tabassum bor edi. "Deviddan," — deb o'yladi u.
  To'satdan gul dastasidagi hayratlanarli xabarni o'qib
  qichqirib yubordi.

USUL — MANTIQQA QARANG:
  ... day      → ob-havo → sunny
  ... silk dress → to'y ko'ylagi rangi → white
  ... bouquet  → gul dastasi qanday? → beautiful
  ... smile    → to'y kuni tabassum → happy
  ... message  → nega qichqirdi? → shocking

DIQQAT — HIKOYA TUZILISHI:
  Boshida hammasi YAXShI (sunny, white, beautiful, happy),
  oxirida esa YOMON (shocking) — bu qarama-qarshilik
  hikoyani QIZIQARLI qiladi.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a wedding    = to'y
  silk         = ipak
  downstairs   = pastga (zinadan)
  a bouquet    = gul dastasi
  a smile      = tabassum
  shocking     = hayratlanarli, dahshatli
  a message    = xabar

tasks.prompt: 1  Everything was ready for Sally's wedding that ............ day.
tasks.whyUz:
'that SUNNY day' = o'sha quyoshli kun.
'sun' + -y → sifat.
To'y kuni — quyoshli, yaxshi ob-havo.
tasks.speak: 1  Everything was ready for Sally's wedding that ............ day.

tasks.prompt: 2  She put on her ............ silk dress ...
tasks.whyUz:
'her WHITE silk dress' = oq ipak ko'ylagi.
An'anaviy to'y ko'ylagi OQ rangda.
'silk' = ipak (ot, lekin sifat vazifasida).
Sifatlar tartibi: rang (white) → material (silk).
tasks.speak: 2  She put on her ............ silk dress ...

tasks.prompt: 3  Just then, a ............ bouquet of flowers arrived for her.
tasks.whyUz:
'a BEAUTIFUL bouquet' = go'zal gul dastasi.
'a bouquet OF flowers' — 'of' shart.
'Just then' — 77-betdagi ketma-ketlik so'zi.
tasks.speak: 3  Just then, a ............ bouquet of flowers arrived for her.

tasks.prompt: 4  Sally had a ............ smile on her face.
tasks.whyUz:
'a HAPPY smile' = baxtli tabassum.
Gul kelgani uchun xursand edi.
'on her face' = yuzida.
tasks.speak: 4  Sally had a ............ smile on her face.

tasks.prompt: 5  Suddenly, she screamed as she read the ............ message on the bouquet.
tasks.whyUz:
'the SHOCKING message' = hayratlanarli xabar.
'shocking' — u qichqirishga sabab bo'lgan.
DIQQAT: bu — hikoyadagi BURILISh nuqtasi.
Oldingi to'rt sifat IJOBIY, bu esa SALBIY.
'as' bu yerda = ...ganda.
tasks.speak: 5  Suddenly, she screamed as she read the ............ message on the bouquet.

sections.title: Reading — the Longleat Safari Park story

exercises.instructionEn: Read the story.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyani o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ MATN:

  One gorgeous, sunny day last summer, Claire and her
  friend Greg went to Longleat Safari Park.

  When they drove into the park, they closed the car
  windows tightly. "We don't want to be a lion's lunch,"
  Claire laughed. Soon, they saw some lions. Greg stopped
  the car very close to the lions and started taking
  pictures of them. The lions roared loudly. "They're
  beautiful, but very scary animals," Claire said. "You're
  right, Claire. Let's go and see the gorillas, now," Greg
  said. He tried to start the car several times, but
  nothing happened. Suddenly, smoke began to come out of
  the engine.

  A few minutes later, the front of the car was on fire.
  They wanted to jump out of the car, but they couldn't
  because the lions were around it. They were both really
  scared. "We'll burn alive!" Claire screamed desperately.
  She beeped the horn and shouted for help. Just then, a
  park ranger came along the road in his jeep. "Hold on,
  we'll get you out!" he shouted. Almost immediately,
  another jeep arrived and chased away the lions. Claire
  and Greg jumped out of the car quickly and ran towards
  the jeep.

  When they were safe inside the jeep, they thanked the
  park ranger for his help. They were still shocked, but

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:

  O'tgan yozning ajoyib, quyoshli kunlaridan birida Kler
  va uning do'sti Greg Longleat safari parkiga borishdi.

  Parkka kirganlarida mashina oynalarini mahkam yopishdi.
  "Sherning tushligi bo'lishni xohlamaymiz," — deb kuldi
  Kler. Tez orada ular bir necha sherni ko'rishdi. Greg
  mashinani sherlarga juda yaqin to'xtatdi va ularni
  suratga ola boshladi. Sherlar baland ovozda bo'kirishdi.
  "Ular go'zal, lekin juda qo'rqinchli hayvonlar," — dedi
  Kler. "To'g'ri aytasan, Kler. Endi gorillalarni ko'rgani
  boraylik," — dedi Greg. U mashinani bir necha marta
  yurgizmoqchi bo'ldi, lekin hech narsa bo'lmadi.
  To'satdan dvigateldan tutun chiqa boshladi.

  Bir necha daqiqadan keyin mashinaning old qismi yona
  boshladi. Ular mashinadan sakrab chiqmoqchi bo'lishdi,
  lekin chiqolmadilar, chunki sherlar atrofda edi. Ikkalasi
  ham juda qo'rqib ketishdi. "Tiriklayin yonamiz!" — deb
  jon holatda qichqirdi Kler. U signal chaldi va yordam
  so'rab qichqirdi. Shu payt yo'l bo'ylab jipda park
  qo'riqchisi keldi. "Chidang, sizni chiqarib olamiz!" —
  deb qichqirdi u. Deyarli darhol yana bir jip yetib keldi
  va sherlarni quvib yubordi. Kler va Greg mashinadan tez
  sakrab chiqib, jip tomon yugurishdi.

  Jip ichida xavfsiz bo'lganlarida ular park qo'riqchisiga
  yordami uchun rahmat aytishdi. Ular hali ham sarosimada

exercises.instructionEn: Read the story: The Boy who Saved the Netherlands.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyani o'qing: Niderlandiyani qutqargan bola.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ MATN:

  Many years ago in Haarlem, Holland, there lived a young
  boy. His name was Hans Brinker and he was eight years
  old. One AUTUMN day, Hans went across the canal to visit
  an old BLIND man. He took the man some biscuits and
  stayed there FOR A WHILE. Then, Hans decided to return
  home.

  "Be careful, Hans," said the old man. "The water in the
  canal usually gets higher in autumn." ON HIS WAY HOME,
  Hans sang a song, watched the RABBITS run around and
  picked some flowers for his mother. Suddenly, the sky got
  dark and heavy rain began to FALL. Hans felt scared and
  started to run. Just then, he heard the sound of water
  FLOWING away. He looked around carefully, then NOTICED a
  very small hole in the dike.

  Hans felt FRIGHTENED because he knew what could happen.
  The small hole could GET BIGGER AND BIGGER. Then, the
  dike could BURST and FLOOD Holland! Hans knew what to do.
  He put his finger in the hole, so no more water could
  come through it. "Please, someone help me!" Hans shouted.
  But there was no one there to help him. After a while, he
  began to feel very cold and tired, but he could not leave
  the dike. All night long, Hans waited and waited ...

  The next morning, a priest WALKED BY and heard Hans'
  CRIES. "I'm trying to stop the water," the boy said. "Can
  you help me?" The priest called some other people and
  they quickly mended the hole. Finally, they took Hans
  home. Everyone was very proud of that BRAVE little boy!


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:

  Ko'p yillar oldin Gollandiyaning Xarlem shahrida bir
  yosh bola yashardi. Uning ismi Hans Brinker edi va u
  sakkiz yoshda edi. Bir kuz kuni Hans keksa ko'r odamni
  ko'rgani kanalning narigi tomoniga bordi. U odamga bir
  oz pechenye olib bordi va u yerda birpas qoldi. So'ng
  Hans uyga qaytishga qaror qildi.

  "Ehtiyot bo'l, Hans," — dedi keksa odam. "Kuzda kanaldagi
  suv odatda ko'tariladi." Uyga qaytayotib Hans qo'shiq
  aytdi, quyonlarning yugurishini tomosha qildi va onasi
  uchun bir oz gul terdi. To'satdan osmon qorayib, kuchli
  yomg'ir yog'a boshladi. Hans qo'rqib ketdi va yugura
  boshladi. Shu payt u suvning oqib ketayotgan ovozini
  eshitdi. U ehtiyotkorlik bilan atrofga qaradi va to'g'onda
  juda kichkina teshikni payqadi.

  Hans qo'rqib ketdi, chunki nima bo'lishi mumkinligini
  bilardi. Kichkina teshik tobora kattalashib borishi
  mumkin edi. So'ng to'g'on yorilib, Gollandiyani suv
  bosishi mumkin edi! Hans nima qilish kerakligini bilardi.
  U barmog'ini teshikka tiqdi va shu bilan suv boshqa
  o'tolmadi. "Iltimos, kimdir menga yordam bersin!" — deb
  qichqirdi Hans. Lekin u yerda unga yordam beradigan hech
  kim yo'q edi. Birozdan keyin u juda sovqotib, charchay
  boshladi, lekin to'g'onni tashlab keta olmasdi. Tun bo'yi
  Hans kutdi va kutdi...

  Ertasi kuni ertalab bir ruhoniy o'sha yerdan o'tib
  ketayotib Hansning qichqiriqlarini eshitdi. "Men suvni
  to'xtatmoqchiman," — dedi bola. "Menga yordam bera
  olasizmi?" Ruhoniy boshqa odamlarni chaqirdi va ular
  tezda teshikni tuzatishdi. Nihoyat, ular Hansni uyiga
  olib borishdi. Hamma o'sha jasur kichkina bolani juda
  faxr bilan eslardi!


HIKOYA TUZILISHI (4 xatboshi):
  1  KIRISH  — qachon, qayerda, kim (77-betdagi qoida)
  2  BOShLANISh — uyga qaytish, yomg'ir, teshik topildi
  3  TUGUN   — xavf, barmoq teshikda, tun bo'yi kutish
  4  YEChIM  — ruhoniy, teshik tuzatildi, faxr

DIQQAT — 'THERE LIVED A YOUNG BOY':
  Odatdagi tartib: 'A young boy lived ...'
  Hikoyalarda esa: 'THERE LIVED a young boy ...'
  Bu — ertak va afsonalarga xos ADABIY tartib.

DIQQAT — 'HANS'' EGALIK APOSTROFI:
  Ism 's' bilan tugagani uchun apostrof OXIRGA qo'yiladi:
     Hans' cries = Hansning qichqiriqlari
  ('Hans's' shakli ham to'g'ri).

GOLLANDIYA VA TO'G'ONLAR:
  Niderlandiyaning katta qismi dengiz sathidan PAST.
  Mamlakatni suv bosishidan TO'G'ONLAR (dikes) himoya
  qiladi. Shuning uchun to'g'ondagi kichkina teshik ham
  butun mamlakat uchun xavfli.
  Bu hikoya — Gollandiyaning mashhur afsonasi.

exercises.instructionEn: We use first, then, after that, just then, next, finally, etc to talk about events which happened one after the other.
exercises.instructionUz: Ketma-ket sodir bo'lgan voqealar haqida gapirish uchun first, then, after that, just then, next, finally kabi so'zlarni ishlatamiz.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:
  first, then, after that, just then, next, finally va h.k.
  so'zlarini BIRIN-KETIN sodir bo'lgan voqealar haqida
  gapirish uchun ishlatamiz.

KITOBDAGI MISOL:
  Tony decided to go on a picnic. FIRST, he made some
  sandwiches, THEN he packed the picnic basket. ...

OLTI SO'Z VA ULARNING O'RNI:

  FIRST      — BIRINCHI voqea
               First, they drove into the park.

  THEN       — keyingi voqea
               Then he stopped the car.

  AFTER THAT — shundan keyin
               After that, he tried to start the car.

  NEXT       — keyin (= then)
               Next, smoke came out of the engine.

  JUST THEN  — AYNAN shu payt (KUTILMAGANDA)
               Just then, a park ranger came along.

  FINALLY    — NIHOYAT, eng oxirgi voqea
               Finally, another jeep chased the lions away.

DIQQAT — VERGUL:
  Gap boshida kelsa, keyin VERGUL qo'yiladi:
     FIRST, they drove into the park.
     JUST THEN, a park ranger came along.
  'then' esa vergulsiz ham kelishi mumkin:
     Then he stopped the car.

DIQQAT — 'JUST THEN' ning ALOHIDA ma'nosi:
  Boshqalari shunchaki ketma-ketlikni bildiradi,
  'just then' esa KUTILMAGAN, to'satdan bo'lgan
  voqeani ta'kidlaydi.
  Hikoyada aynan qutqaruv kelganda ishlatilgan.

BOSHQA FOYDALI SO'ZLAR (hikoyadan):
  suddenly            = to'satdan
  soon                = tez orada
  a few minutes later = bir necha daqiqadan keyin
  almost immediately  = deyarli darhol
  when                = ...ganda
  in the end          = oxir-oqibat

exercises.instructionEn: Adjectives describe nouns. Adverbs usually describe verbs.
exercises.instructionUz: Sifat otni aniqlaydi. Ravish odatda fe'lni aniqlaydi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

  SIFAT (adjective) — OTNI aniqlaydi.
     He is a CAREFUL DRIVER.
     (What kind of driver is he? CAREFUL.)
     = U qanday haydovchi? Ehtiyotkor.

  RAVISH (adverb) — odatda FE'LNI aniqlaydi.
     He drives CAREFULLY.
     (How does he drive? CAREFULLY.)

     a careful driver, a beautiful day, scary animals

  'HOW ...?' (qanday qilib?) → RAVISH
     drives carefully, roared loudly, screamed desperately

     otdan OLDIN:        a CAREFUL driver
     'to be' dan KEYIN:  He is CAREFUL.

  loud    → loudly
  quick   → quickly
  tight   → tightly
  desperate → desperately

ISTISNOLAR:

  fast → FAST   (o'zgarmaydi)
  hard → HARD   (o'zgarmaydi)
  early → EARLY (o'zgarmaydi)

  park ...' deb yozishimiz mumkin.

  'One GORGEOUS, SUNNY day last summer ...'

exercises.instructionEn: Study the examples, then complete the rules.
exercises.instructionUz: Misollarni o'rganing, so'ng qoidalarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI MISOLLAR:

  He was a CAREFUL driver.  →  He drove CAREFULLY.
  The HAPPY child smiled.   →  The child smiled HAPPILY.
  She was a FAST runner.    →  She could run very FAST.
  They were GOOD singers.   →  They sang very WELL.

UCHTA QOIDA:

  1) Ravishni odatda sifatga -LY qo'shib yasaymiz.
        careful → carefully
        loud    → loudly
        quick   → quickly

  2) Sifat UNDOSH + Y bilan tugasa, -Y ni tushirib,
     -ILY qo'shamiz.
        happy  → happily
        easy   → easily
        lucky  → luckily

  3) Ba'zi ravishlar SIFAT bilan BIR XIL shaklda bo'ladi.
        hard  → hard
        fast  → fast
        early → early
     LEKIN:  good → WELL

DIQQAT — 2-QOIDA FAQAT UNDOSH + Y UCHUN:
  UNDOSH + Y → -ILY
     hapPY  → happily   (p — undosh)
     easY   → easily    (s — undosh)
  Bu — o'tgan zamondagi -IED qoidasiga o'xshash
  (marry → married).

DIQQAT — 3-QOIDADAGI TUZOQ:
  'hardly' shakli BOR, lekin ma'nosi BOShQA!
     hard   = qattiq, ko'p  (He works HARD.)
     hardly = deyarli emas  (He HARDLY works.)
  Ikkalasi BUTUNLAY teskari ma'no beradi.

  Shunga o'xshash:
     late   = kech          (He came LATE.)
     lately = so'nggi paytda (I haven't seen him LATELY.)

exercises.instructionEn: We can join sentences with words such as and, but, because, so, then, when, etc.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni and, but, because, so, then, when kabi so'zlar bilan bog'lashimiz mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI OLTI MISOL:

  AND — qo'shimcha, ketma-ketlik
     She stood up AND walked towards the door.
     (U o'rnidan turdi va eshik tomon yurdi.)

  BUT — QARAMA-QARShILIK
     He looked out of the window, BUT he couldn't see
     anything.
     (U derazadan qaradi, lekin hech narsa ko'ra olmadi.)

  BECAUSE — SABAB
     He closed the window BECAUSE it was very cold outside.
     (U derazani yopdi, chunki tashqarida juda sovuq edi.)

  SO — NATIJA
     It was very late, SO he decided to go home.
     (Juda kech edi, shuning uchun uyga ketishga qaror qildi.)

  THEN — KETMA-KETLIK
     He opened the door, THEN turned on the lights.
     (U eshikni ochdi, so'ng chiroqlarni yoqdi.)

  WHEN — VAQT
     He was in bed WHEN he heard a strange noise.
     (U to'shakda edi, o'shanda g'alati shovqin eshitdi.)


ENG MUHIM JUFTLIK — 'BECAUSE' va 'SO':

  Ikkalasi ham SABAB-NATIJA aloqasini ko'rsatadi,
  lekin TARTIBI TESKARI:

     NATIJA + BECAUSE + SABAB
        He closed the window BECAUSE it was cold.
        (yopdi ← chunki sovuq edi)

     SABAB + SO + NATIJA
        It was cold, SO he closed the window.
        (sovuq edi → shuning uchun yopdi)

  Ma'no BIR XIL, faqat tartib boshqacha.

DIQQAT — VERGUL:
  'but' va 'so' oldidan odatda VERGUL qo'yiladi.
  'and', 'because', 'when' oldidan odatda vergul YO'Q.

DIQQAT — EGA TAKRORLANMASLIGI:
  'and' va 'then' bilan bog'langanda, ega BIR XIL bo'lsa
  ikkinchisida tushirib qoldirsa bo'ladi:
     She stood up and (she) walked towards the door.
     He opened the door, then (he) turned on the lights.

exercises.instructionUz: Sifat otni aniqlaydi. Sifat birlikda ham, ko'plikda ham bir xil bo'ladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

  Sifat OTNI aniqlaydi.
  Sifat BIRLIKDA ham, KO'PLIKDA ham BIR XIL bo'ladi.

  Look at this TALL tree.    (birlik — bitta daraxt)
  Look at these TALL trees.  (ko'plik — bir necha daraxt)


ENG MUHIM QOIDA — SIFAT HECH QAChON -S OLMAYDI:

  tall trees      ✓
  talls trees     ✗ XATO

  beautiful flowers   ✓
  beautifuls flowers  ✗ XATO

  Bu — o'zbek tilidan farq qiladigan muhim nuqta.
  Ingliz tilida OT ko'plik bo'ladi, SIFAT esa O'ZGARMAYDI.


DIQQAT — 'THIS' va 'THESE' O'ZGARADI:
  THIS tall tree    (birlik)
  THESE tall trees  (ko'plik)

  Ko'rsatish olmoshi OT bilan birga o'zgaradi,
  lekin SIFAT o'zgarmaydi.

  To'liq jadval:
     this  → these   (yaqin)
     that  → those   (uzoq)


SIFAT GAPDA QAYERDA TURADI:

  1) OTDAN OLDIN:
        a TALL tree;  a BEAUTIFUL day;  SCARY animals

  2) 'TO BE' dan KEYIN:
        The tree is TALL.
        The animals were SCARY.

  3) 'FEEL', 'LOOK', 'SEEM' dan KEYIN:
        He felt FRIGHTENED.
        They look FRIENDLY.


BIR NEChTA SIFAT BIRGA KELSA:
  Coursebook 77-betdagi hikoyada:
     'One GORGEOUS, SUNNY day' — ikki sifat, vergul bilan.
     'a little old cottage' — ikki sifat, vergulsiz.

  Odatdagi tartib:
     baho → o'lcham → yosh → rang → material
     a nice   little   old    white   silk   dress

exercises.instructionEn: Adverbs usually describe verbs. Form of adverbs.
exercises.instructionUz: Ravish odatda fe'lni aniqlaydi. Ravishning yasalishi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

  Ravish odatda FE'LNI aniqlaydi.
     He drives CAREFULLY.
     (How does he drive? CAREFULLY.)
     = U qanday haydaydi? Ehtiyotkorlik bilan.


FORM — UChTA QOIDA:

  1) Ravishni odatda sifatga -LY qo'shib yasaymiz.
        careful → carefully

  2) Sifat UNDOSH + Y bilan tugasa, -Y ni tushirib,
     -ILY qo'shamiz.
        lucky → luckily

  3) Ba'zi ravishlar SIFAT bilan BIR XIL shaklda bo'ladi.
        hard  → hard
        fast  → fast
        early → early

     ESLATMA:  good → WELL


SIFAT va RAVISHNI QANDAY AJRATISH:

  Savol bering:
     'WHAT KIND OF ...?' (qanday?)     → SIFAT
     'HOW ...?' (qanday qilib?)        → RAVISH

  Misol:
     He is a CAREFUL driver.  (qanday haydovchi? → SIFAT)
     He drives CAREFULLY.     (qanday haydaydi? → RAVISH)


GAPDA JOYI:
  SIFAT  — otdan OLDIN yoki 'to be' dan KEYIN
  RAVISH — fe'ldan KEYIN (yoki ba'zan oldin)


DIQQAT — -LY BILAN TUGAGAN SIFATLAR:
  friendly, lovely, silly, lonely, ugly — bular SIFAT!
  Ular RAVISH EMAS.
     He smiled in a FRIENDLY way.  ✓
     He smiled FRIENDLY.           ✗ XATO


DIQQAT — 'HARD' va 'HARDLY':
  hard   = qattiq, ko'p   (He works HARD.)
  hardly = deyarli emas   (He HARDLY works.)
  Ma'nosi BUTUNLAY TESKARI!

  Shunga o'xshash:
     late   = kech           ↔  lately = so'nggi paytda
     near   = yaqin          ↔  nearly = deyarli

exercises.instructionEn: We use linking words to join sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni birlashtirish uchun bog'lovchilardan foydalanamiz.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:
  Gaplarni BIRLAShTIRISh uchun bog'lovchilardan
  foydalanamiz.

OLTI MISOL — HAR BIRI IKKI SHAKLDA BERILGAN:

  AND — qo'shimcha, ketma-ketlik
     He locked the door. He left the house.
     → He locked the door AND left the house.
     DIQQAT: ikkinchi 'he' TUShIB QOLDI.

  BUT — QARAMA-QARShILIK
     Tom wanted to watch TV. I didn't.
     → Tom wanted to watch TV, BUT I didn't.

  BECAUSE — SABAB
     Julie was happy. She didn't have any homework.
     → Julie was happy BECAUSE she didn't have any homework.

  SO — NATIJA
     I was very tired. I decided to go to bed.
     → I was very tired, SO I decided to go to bed.

  THEN — KETMA-KETLIK
     She parked the car. She went inside.
     → She parked the car, THEN she went inside.

  WHEN — VAQT
     He was at work. He heard the news.
     → He was at work WHEN he heard the news.


QAY BIRINI TANLASH — SAVOL BERING:

  Ikkinchi gap SABABNI aytadimi?         → BECAUSE
  Ikkinchi gap birinchisining NATIJASImi? → SO
  Ikkinchi gap QARAMA-QARShImi?          → BUT
  Ikkinchi gap QAChON bo'lganini aytadimi? → WHEN
  Ketma-ket sodir bo'ldimi?               → AND yoki THEN


BECAUSE va SO — TARTIBI TESKARI:

     NATIJA + BECAUSE + SABAB
        I went to bed BECAUSE I was tired.

     SABAB + SO + NATIJA
        I was tired, SO I went to bed.

  Ma'no BIR XIL, faqat tartib boshqacha.


VERGUL QOIDASI:
  BUT, SO, THEN oldidan → VERGUL qo'yiladi
  AND, BECAUSE, WHEN oldidan → odatda vergul YO'Q


EGA TUShIB QOLIShI:
  'AND' va 'THEN' bilan bog'langanda, ega BIR XIL bo'lsa
  ikkinchisida tushirib qoldirsa bo'ladi:
     He locked the door and (he) left the house.  ✓

  Lekin kitobdagi 'then' misolida ega SAQLANGAN:
     She parked the car, then SHE went inside.
  Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.

lekin tushirsa ham bo'ladi.

exercises.instructionUz: Harakat predloglari — rasmlarga qarang.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N RASM VA O'N PREDLOG:

  PAST     — pochta qutisi YONIDAN o'tib
  TOWARDS  — ayol TOMON borish
  ACROSS   — ko'chani KESIB o'tish
  ALONG    — ko'cha BO'YLAB yurish
  UP       — zinadan YUQORIGA
  DOWN     — zinadan PASTGA
  UNDER    — ko'prik OSTIDAN
  INTO     — eshikdan IChKARIGA
  OVER     — to'siq USTIDAN sakrab
  THROUGH  — tunnel IChIDAN


ENG KO'P ADAShTIRILADIGAN JUFTLIKLAR:

  ALONG ↔ ACROSS
     ALONG  — UZUNASIGA (ko'cha bo'ylab yurish)
     ACROSS — KO'NDALANG (ko'chani kesib o'tish)
     Rasmlarda aniq ko'rinadi: 'across' da odam
     ZEBRA yo'lakda ko'chani kesib o'tyapti,
     'along' da esa piyodalar yo'lida yurib ketyapti.

  THROUGH ↔ ACROSS
     THROUGH — biror narsaning IChIDAN
               (tunnel, o'rmon — tepasi yopiq)
     ACROSS  — biror narsaning USTIDAN, yuzasi bo'ylab
               (ko'cha, dala — tepasi ochiq)

  OVER ↔ UNDER
     OVER  — USTIDAN (tegmasdan sakrab)
     UNDER — OSTIDAN

  UP ↔ DOWN
     UP   — yuqoriga
     DOWN — pastga

  INTO ↔ OUT OF
     INTO   — ichkariga
     OUT OF — tashqariga
     (kitobda faqat 'into' berilgan)

  TO ↔ TOWARDS
     TO      — yetib borish (maqsad)
     TOWARDS — ...TOMON (yo'nalish)


DIQQAT — 'PAST' IKKI XIL SO'Z:
  'past' PREDLOG = yonidan o'tib
     He walked PAST the postbox.
  'the past' OT = o'tmish
     'the past simple' = oddiy o'tgan zamon (10-unit)


ESLATMA:
  Coursebook 78-betda ham shu predloglar bor edi
  (Ralf ot minadigan hikoyada).

exercises.instructionEn: Ralph went horse-riding in the countryside. First, look at the pictures and use the prepositions to fill in the gaps in the text.
exercises.instructionUz: Ralf qishloqda ot mingani bordi. Avval rasmlarga qarang va predloglar bilan matndagi bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  It was a lovely day, so Ralph decided to go for a ride in
  the countryside. He got on his horse and rode out of the
  field. At first, everything was fine. He went ALONG the
  road, THROUGH the tunnel and TOWARDS the forest. Then, he
  went UP the hill. The view from there was beautiful!
  After that, he went DOWN the other side of the hill, PAST
  a little old cottage and UNDER the bridge. After that, he
  went ACROSS a field. Suddenly, everything went wrong! A
  tractor scared the horse and it jumped OVER the fence.
  Ralph fell off the horse and INTO the lake. He got very
  wet! It was a horrible experience!


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Kun ajoyib edi, shuning uchun Ralf qishloqqa ot mingani
  borishga qaror qildi. U otiga mindi va daladan chiqib
  ketdi. Dastlab hammasi yaxshi edi. U yo'l bo'ylab,
  tunnel ichidan o'tib, o'rmon tomon bordi. So'ng tepalikka
  chiqdi. U yerdan manzara go'zal edi! Shundan keyin
  tepalikning narigi tomonidan tushdi, kichkina eski kulba
  yonidan o'tdi va ko'prik ostidan o'tdi. Shundan keyin
  dala bo'ylab bordi. To'satdan hammasi noto'g'ri ketdi!
  Traktor otni qo'rqitdi va u panjara ustidan sakradi.
  Ralf otdan yiqilib ko'lga tushdi. U juda ho'l bo'ldi!
  Bu dahshatli tajriba edi!


RASMLAR TARTIBI (matnga qarab):
  1  e  — along the road
  2  h  — through the tunnel
  3  b  — towards the forest
  4  d  — up the hill

RO'YXAT: and, but, so, because, when

5 ta bog'lovchi, 10 ta bo'shliq — demak ba'zilari
BIR NEChA MARTA ishlatiladi:
  and     → 3 marta
  but     → 2 marta
  so      → 2 marta
  when    → 2 marta
  because → 1 marta

TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Sally was tired, SO she decided to go to bed. She was
  asleep WHEN the telephone rang. She got up AND answered
  the phone BUT no one spoke on the other end. Sally hung
  up the phone AND went back to bed. She couldn't sleep, SO
  she went into the kitchen AND made some tea. She was
  still in the kitchen WHEN the phone rang again. Sally
  didn't want to answer it, BUT she did. Once again, no one
  spoke on the other end. Sally hung up the phone. She felt
  nervous BECAUSE she was alone in the house. Suddenly,
  there was a knock at the door!


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Salli charchagan edi, shuning uchun yotishga qaror qildi.
  U uxlab yotgan edi, o'shanda telefon jiringladi. U turdi
  va telefonga javob berdi, lekin narigi tomondan hech kim
  gapirmadi. Salli go'shakni qo'ydi va yana yotdi. U uxlay
  olmadi, shuning uchun oshxonaga bordi va choy damladi. U
  hali oshxonada edi, o'shanda telefon yana jiringladi.
  Salli javob bermoqchi emas edi, lekin javob berdi. Yana
  bir bor narigi tomondan hech kim gapirmadi. Salli
  go'shakni qo'ydi. U asabiylashdi, chunki uyda yolg'iz
  edi. To'satdan eshik taqilladi!

DIQQAT — BU HAM HIKOYA:
  Matn qo'rqinchli hikoya uslubida yozilgan.
  Oxiri ochiq qoldirilgan ('Suddenly, there was a knock
  at the door!') — bu Coursebook 79 va 81-betlardagi
  hikoya yozish qoidalariga mos.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  asleep       = uxlab yotgan
  to ring (rang) = jiringlamoq
  to hang up   = go'shakni qo'ymoq
  on the other end = narigi tomonda (telefonda)
  once again   = yana bir bor
  alone        = yolg'iz
  a knock      = taqillatish
  to make tea  = choy damlamoq

exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI BOG'LOVChI, OLTI GAP —
har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.

Bu tekshirish uchun yaxshi belgi: agar bittasi
ikki marta chiqsa, biror joyda xato qilgansiz.

USUL — IKKINChI QISMGA SAVOL BERING:
  'Nega?' javobi bormi?          → BECAUSE
  Birinchisining NATIJASImi?      → SO
  QARAMA-QARShImi?                → BUT
  'Qachon?' javobi bormi?         → WHEN
  'First' bor, keyin nima?        → THEN
  Shunchaki ketma-ketlikmi?       → AND

tasks.prompt: 1  Mike got up early ............ he wanted to study for his test.
tasks.whyUz:
BECAUSE — SABAB.
'he wanted to study' — erta turishning sababi.
'study FOR a test' = testga tayyorlanmoq.
tasks.speak: 1  Mike got up early ............ he wanted to study for his test.

tasks.prompt: 2  First, I went to the supermarket, ............ I went to the post office.
tasks.whyUz:
THEN — ketma-ketlik.
'First' so'zi bor → uning juftligi 'THEN'.
Coursebook 77-betdagi ketma-ketlik so'zlari:
first, then, after that, finally.
tasks.speak: 2  First, I went to the supermarket, ............ I went to the post office.

tasks.prompt: 3  Sophie was hungry, ............ she made a sandwich.
tasks.whyUz:
SO — NATIJA.
SABAB (och edi) → NATIJA (buterbrod tayyorladi).
Oldidan VERGUL bor.
'make a sandwich' — 'do' EMAS, MAKE.
tasks.speak: 3  Sophie was hungry, ............ she made a sandwich.

tasks.prompt: 4  He turned off the lights ............ went to bed.
tasks.promptUz: Ikki harakat ketma-ket, ega BIR XIL
tasks.whyUz:
AND — ketma-ketlik.
DIQQAT: ikkinchi qismda ega ('he') TUShIB QOLGAN —
bu 'and' ning aniq belgisi.
'turn off' = o'chirmoq (aksi: turn on = yoqmoq).
tasks.speak: 4  He turned off the lights ............ went to bed.

tasks.prompt: 5  I was happy ............ I heard the great news.
tasks.whyUz:
WHEN — VAQT.
'I heard the great news' — xursand bo'lgan PAYT.
hear → HEARD (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'the news' — SANALMAYDIGAN, doim 'the' bilan.
tasks.speak: 5  I was happy ............ I heard the great news.

tasks.prompt: 6  David likes rock music, ............ his sister doesn't.
tasks.whyUz:
BUT — QARAMA-QARShILIK.
'David LIKES' ↔ 'his sister DOESN'T' — teskari.
Oldidan VERGUL bor.
'doesn't' = doesn't like rock music (qisqartirilgan).
Coursebook 79-betdagi 12-mashqning 10-bandiga o'xshash.
tasks.speak: 6  David likes rock music, ............ his sister doesn't.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the appropriate preposition from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan mos predlogni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta predlog, 8 ta bo'shliq):
  over, along, up, towards, down, under, through, into

Har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.
Bu tekshirish uchun yaxshi belgi.

SAKKIZ RASM:
  1  O't o'chiruvchi daraxtdagi mushukni qutqarish uchun
     narvondan chiqyapti.
  2  Ayol fotoapparat ob'ektividan qarab turibdi.
  3  Qo'l disk pleyerga CD solyapti.
  4  Yengil atletikachi to'siq ustidan sakrayapti.
  5  Mashina egri-bugri yo'lda ketyapti.
  6  Yuguruvchi marra chizig'i tomon yuguryapti.
  7  Bola sirg'anchiqdan pastga tushyapti.
  8  Erkak narvon ostidan o'tib ketyapti.

USUL — HARAKAT YO'NALIShIGA QARANG:
  yuqoriga     → up
  pastga       → down
  ustidan      → over
  ostidan      → under
  ichkariga    → into
  ichidan      → through
  uzunasiga    → along
  ...tomon     → towards

tasks.whyUz:
'climbed UP the ladder' = narvondan yuqoriga chiqdi.
Rasmda o't o'chiruvchi daraxtdagi mushukni qutqarish uchun
yuqoriga chiqyapti.
Aksi: down.
Coursebook 81-betdagi 21-mashqda ham 'climbed onto a ladder'.

tasks.prompt: 2  She is looking ............ the camera lens.
tasks.whyUz:
'looking THROUGH the lens' = ob'ektiv ichidan qarab turibdi.
THROUGH — biror narsaning IChIDAN.
Shunga o'xshash: look through a window, look through binoculars.
'a lens' = ob'ektiv, linza.
tasks.speak: 2  She is looking ............ the camera lens.

tasks.prompt: 3  He's putting a CD ............ the CD player.
tasks.whyUz:
'putting a CD INTO the player' = diskni pleyerga solyapti.
INTO — IChKARIGA harakat.
Aksi: out of.
'a CD player' = disk pleyeri (Workbook 38-betda ham bor edi).
tasks.speak: 3  He's putting a CD ............ the CD player.

tasks.whyUz:
'jumping OVER the hurdle' = to'siq ustidan sakrayapti.
OVER — USTIDAN, tegmasdan.
'a hurdle' = to'siq (yengil atletikada).
Aksi: under.

'driving ALONG the road' = yo'l bo'ylab ketyapti.
ALONG — UZUNASIGA harakat.
DIQQAT: 'across the road' bo'lsa yo'lni KESIB o'tgan
bo'lardi — rasmda esa yo'l bo'ylab ketishyapti.
Coursebook 78-betda ham: 'He went ALONG the road'.

tasks.prompt: 6  He is running ............ the finishing line.
tasks.whyUz:
'running TOWARDS the finishing line' = marra tomon yuguryapti.
TOWARDS — YO'NALISh (hali yetib bormagan).
'the finishing line' = marra chizig'i.
Coursebook 77-betda ham: 'ran TOWARDS the jeep'.
tasks.speak: 6  He is running ............ the finishing line.

tasks.prompt: 7  The child is going ............ the slide.
tasks.whyUz:
'going DOWN the slide' = sirg'anchiqdan pastga tushyapti.
DOWN — PASTGA.
1-band bilan JUFT: up ↔ down.
'a slide' = sirg'anchiq.
tasks.speak: 7  The child is going ............ the slide.

tasks.prompt: 8  The man is going ............ the ladder.
tasks.whyUz:
'going UNDER the ladder' = narvon ostidan o'tyapti.
UNDER — OSTIDAN.
4-band bilan JUFT: over ↔ under.
MADANIY ESLATMA: Britaniyada narvon ostidan o'tish
omadsizlik keltiradi deb hisoblanadi —
rasmda odamning yuzi xavotirli.
tasks.speak: 8  The man is going ............ the ladder.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni oddiy o'tgan zamonga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A: Where DID YOU GO last night?
  B: I WENT to Ann's party.
  A: DID YOU HAVE fun?
  B: Oh, yes! It WAS great! I came home very late and I
     WENT straight to bed.

O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  A: Kecha kechqurun qayerga bording?
  B: Annning ziyofatiga bordim.
  A: Yaxshi vaqt o'tkazdingmi?
  B: Ha, albatta! Zo'r edi! Uyga juda kech keldim va
     to'g'ri yotdim.

UCh XIL SHAKL BU DIALOGDA:

  SO'ROQ  → DID + ega + ASOSIY shakl
     Did you GO?  /  Did you HAVE?

  TASDIQ  → fe'lning O'TGAN shakli
     I WENT.  /  I WENT straight to bed.

  'BE' fe'li → WAS ('did' KERAK EMAS)
     It WAS great!

ENG MUHIM DIQQAT:
  Bir dialogda BIR XIL fe'l ikki xil shaklda:
     did you GO?  (asosiy shakl)
     I WENT.      (o'tgan shakl)

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to have fun     = yaxshi vaqt o'tkazmoq
  straight to bed = to'g'ri yotoqqa

tasks.promptUz: 'last night' — o'tgan zamon; qavsda ega bor → so'roq
tasks.whyUz:
SO'ROQ shakli: DID + you + GO (asosiy shakl).
'did you went' XATO.
'last night' — past simple belgisi.

TASDIQ shakli: go → WENT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
1-band bilan SOLIShTIRING: savolda 'go', javobda 'went'.
"Ann'S party" — egalik apostrofi.

SO'ROQ: DID + you + HAVE (asosiy shakl).
'did you had' XATO.
'have fun' = yaxshi vaqt o'tkazmoq.

'be' → WAS.
'It' BIRLIK → was.
DIQQAT: 'to be' fe'lida 'did' KERAK EMAS.

tasks.prompt: 5  B: I came home very late and I ............ (go) straight to bed.
tasks.whyUz:
go → WENT.
'came' ham o'tgan shaklda (come → came) —
gap butunlay o'tgan zamonda.
'go straight to bed' = to'g'ri yotmoq.
'go to bed' — artikl YO'Q.
tasks.speak: 5  B: I came home very late and I ............ (go) straight to bed.

exercises.instructionEn: Make questions to which the words in bold type are the answers, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin yozilgan so'zlar javob bo'ladigan savollar tuzing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  JOHN drove to work.
     → WHO drove to work?


ENG MUHIM QOIDA — QALIN SO'Z EGAMI YOKI TO'LDIRUVChIMI:

  Agar qalin so'z EGA bo'lsa (gapning boshida, harakatni
  bajaruvchi):
     → WHO ...?  va 'DID' KERAK EMAS
     → fe'l O'TGAN shaklda qoladi

        JOHN drove to work.
        → Who DROVE to work?      ('did' YO'Q)

  Agar qalin so'z TO'LDIRUVChI bo'lsa (harakat tushadigan
  narsa):
     → WHAT ...?  va 'DID' KERAK
     → fe'l ASOSIY shaklda

        Kate did THE SHOPPING.
        → What DID Kate DO?       ('did' BOR)

  Agar qalin so'z JOY bo'lsa:
     → WHERE ...?  va 'DID' KERAK

        They went to THE BEACH.
        → Where DID they GO?


BU MASHQDAGI TAQSIMOT:

  EGA so'ralgan ('did' YO'Q) — 1, 3, 5, 7, 9-bandlar:
     John, Alex, Sean, Helen, Jimmy

  TO'LDIRUVChI so'ralgan ('did' BOR) — 2, 4, 6, 8-bandlar:
     the shopping, the door, noises, a red dress

  JOY so'ralgan ('did' BOR) — 10-band:
     the beach


DIQQAT — 9-BAND BOShQAChA:
  'Jimmy IS a careful driver.' — 'to be' fe'li,
  hozirgi zamon → 'WHO IS a careful driver?'
  ('did' ham, o'tgan zamon ham yo'q)

tasks.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
'John' — EGA → WHO ...?
'did' KERAK EMAS, fe'l O'TGAN shaklda ('drove').

'the shopping' — TO'LDIRUVChI → WHAT ...?
'did' KERAK → 'What DID Kate DO?'
DIQQAT: 'do' fe'li IKKI marta —
'did' (yordamchi) + 'do' (asosiy).

'Alex' — EGA → WHO ...?
'did' KERAK EMAS, fe'l 'WENT' shaklida qoladi.
1-band bilan bir xil naqsh.

'the door' — TO'LDIRUVChI → WHAT ...?
'What DID she OPEN?' — 'open' asosiy shaklda.
'did she opened' XATO.

'Sean' — EGA → WHO ...?
Fe'l 'VISITED' shaklida qoladi.

'noises' — TO'LDIRUVChI → WHAT ...?
'What DID they HEAR?' — 'hear' asosiy shaklda
('heard' EMAS).
Coursebook 79-betdagi 15-mashqda ham 'noises' bor edi.

'Helen' — EGA → WHO ...?
Fe'l 'CALLED' shaklida qoladi.
Coursebook 81-betdagi favqulodda xizmat mavzusiga bog'liq.

'a red dress' — TO'LDIRUVChI → WHAT ...?
'What DID Sophie WEAR?' — 'wear' asosiy shaklda
('wore' EMAS).
wear → WORE (noto'g'ri fe'l).

'Jimmy' — EGA → WHO ...?
DIQQAT — BU BAND BOShQAChA:
fe'l 'IS' ('to be', HOZIRGI zamon) —
shuning uchun 'did' ham, o'tgan zamon ham YO'Q.
'a careful driver' — 48 va 49-betlardagi misol.

'the beach' — JOY → WHERE ...?
'Where DID they GO?' — 'go' asosiy shaklda.
DIQQAT: javobda 'TO the beach' bor edi, savolda 'to'
KERAK EMAS — 'where' allaqachon joyni so'raydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU MASHQ 1-11 UNITLARDAGI BARCHA ZAMONLARNI TEKShIRADI:

  PRESENT SIMPLE     — odat, doimiy fakt
     belgilari: every day, usually, always
     yoki umuman vaqt belgisi yo'q (doimiy holat)

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS — ayni damda
     belgilari: now, at the moment

  PAST SIMPLE        — o'tmishda tugagan
     belgilari: yesterday, last night, ... ago

  WILL (kelasi zamon) — bashorat yoki AYNI DAMDA
     qabul qilingan QAROR
     belgilari: tomorrow, tonight, soon
     yoki hozirgi holatga javoban qaror

USUL: avval VAQT so'zini toping, so'ng zamonni tanlang.

tasks.prompt: 1  It's too hot. I ............ (open) the window.
tasks.whyUz:
'It's too hot' — hozirgi holat.
Unga javoban AYNI DAMDA qaror qabul qilinyapti →
WILL ('ll open).
10-unitdagi qoida: 'will' — bashorat va shu ondagi qaror.
'I'll open the window' = derazani ochaman.
DIQQAT: 'I open' (present simple) bo'lsa —
bu odat bo'lardi, mantiqsiz.
tasks.speak: 1  It's too hot. I ............ (open) the window.

tasks.prompt: 2  Yesterday, when she ............ (come) home from work, ...
tasks.whyUz:
'Yesterday' → PAST SIMPLE.
come → CAME (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'come home FROM work' — 'from' shart.
tasks.speak: 2  Yesterday, when she ............ (come) home from work, ...

tasks.prompt: 2  ... she ............ (find) a dog in the garden.
tasks.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE. find → FOUND (noto'g'ri fe'l).
Ikkala fe'l ham o'tgan zamonda —
'when' ikkisini bog'laydi (49-betdagi qoida).
tasks.speak: 2  ... she ............ (find) a dog in the garden.

tasks.whyUz:
'at the moment' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
SO'ROQ shakli: ARE + you + WORKING.
'work ON something' = biror narsa ustida ishlamoq —
'on' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.

'last night' → PAST SIMPLE.
SO'ROQ shakli: DID + you + ENJOY (asosiy shakl).
'did you enjoyed' XATO.
9-mashqning 3-bandiga o'xshash.

tasks.prompt: 5  She ............ (live) in a big house outside London.
tasks.whyUz:
Yashash joyi — DOIMIY holat, vaqt belgisi yo'q →
PRESENT SIMPLE.
'She' 3-shaxs BIRLIK → live + S = LIVES.
'outside London' = London tashqarisida.
tasks.speak: 5  She ............ (live) in a big house outside London.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose the correct item.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU MASHQ 1-11 UNITLARNING HAMMASINI TEKShIRADI:
  zamonlar, predloglar, olmoshlar, 'there is/are',
  'can/could', savol so'zlari.

ZAMON TANLASh — VAQT SO'ZIGA QARANG:

  PAST SIMPLE:
     yesterday, last weekend, last night,
     when she was four

  PRESENT SIMPLE:
     always, usually, every day
     yoki doimiy holat (vaqt belgisi yo'q)

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
     right now, at the moment, today

  WILL:
     in the future
     yoki AYNI DAMDA qabul qilingan qaror

USUL: har bir bandda avval VAQT so'zini toping.

tasks.prompt: 1  We ............ dinner at my parents' house yesterday.
tasks.whyUz:
'yesterday' → PAST SIMPLE.
have → HAD (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'have dinner' = kechki ovqat yemoq.
"my parents' house" — KO'PLIK otda apostrof 's' dan KEYIN.

'jump OVER a fence' = panjara ustidan sakramoq.
OVER — USTIDAN, tegmasdan.
Coursebook 78-betda ham: 'it jumped OVER the fence'.
'across' — ko'ndalang (dala, ko'cha uchun);
'on' — ustida turish (harakat emas).

'right now' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'They' KO'PLIK → ARE + eating.
DIQQAT: 'C eating' — yordamchi fe'lsiz -ing shakli
yolg'iz ishlatilmaydi.

tasks.prompt: 4  I think there ............ underwater cities in the future.
tasks.whyUz:
'in the future' → KELASI zamon → WILL BE.
'I think ... will ...' — BAShORAT qolipi (10-unit).
'underwater' = suv ostidagi.
DIQQAT: 'there will be' — 'there is/are' ning kelasi shakli.

'yesterday' → PAST SIMPLE → FINISHED.
'finish + fe'l-ing' = ...ni tugatmoq.
'finish PAINTING' — 'to paint' EMAS.

tasks.prompt: 6  I ............ to a party last weekend.
tasks.whyUz:
'last weekend' → PAST SIMPLE.
go → WENT (noto'g'ri fe'l).

'at the moment' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'Tina' BIRLIK → IS + sleeping.

'yesterday' → PAST SIMPLE.
write → WROTE (noto'g'ri fe'l).

tasks.prompt: 9  I live in a flat ............ the city centre.
tasks.whyUz:
'IN the city centre' = shahar markazida.
Joy ichida bo'lish → IN.
'a flat' = kvartira.
DIQQAT: bu HARAKAT predlogi emas — joy predlogi.

tasks.prompt: 10  She ............ count to ten when she was four.
tasks.whyUz:
'when she WAS four' → O'TGAN zamon → COULD.
9-unitdagi qoida: 'can' ning o'tgan shakli — COULD.
'count TO ten' = o'ngacha sanamoq.
'can't' — ma'nosi ham mos kelmaydi (4 yoshli bola
o'ngacha sanay oladi).

tasks.prompt: 11  ............ did you go out to dinner with?
tasks.whyUz:
Gap oxirida 'WITH' bor → ODAM so'ralmoqda → WHO.
'Who did you go out to dinner WITH?'
= Kim bilan ovqatlanishga chiqding?
DIQQAT: 'with' gap OXIRIDA qoladi —
bu 'who' ning aniq belgisi.

'today' + 'heavily' → hozir sodir bo'layotgan
harakat → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'It' → IS + snowing.
DIQQAT: 'A snowing' — yordamchi fe'lsiz -ing yolg'iz
ishlatilmaydi.
'heavily' — RAVISh (11-unitdagi qoida).

tasks.prompt: 13  Do you believe there ............ life on other planets?
tasks.whyUz:
'life' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot → THERE IS.
'there are' KO'PLIK otlar bilan ishlatiladi.
'a planet' = sayyora.
'to believe' = ishonmoq.

'put ON the shelf' = javonga (ustiga) qo'ymoq.
Javon — tekis yuza → ON.
'a shelf' = javon;  ko'pligi: shelves.
'in' bo'lsa yopiq joy bo'lardi (in the box).

'Help ME!' — fe'ldan keyin TO'LDIRUVChI olmosh → ME.
'my' — EGALIK sifati, otdan oldin turadi (my book).
'mine' — EGALIK olmoshi, ot kerak emas (It's mine).
Coursebook 80-betda ham: 'Please, someone help me!'

tasks.prompt: 16  She always ............ to bed at ten o'clock.
tasks.whyUz:
'always' → PRESENT SIMPLE (odat).
'She' 3-shaxs BIRLIK → go + ES = GOES.
DIQQAT: oxiri 'o' bo'lsa -ES qo'shiladi.
'go to bed' — artikl YO'Q.

tasks.prompt: 17  I ............ my umbrella with me because it's raining.
tasks.whyUz:
'because it's raining' — HOZIRGI holat.
Unga javoban AYNI DAMDA qaror → WILL TAKE.
50-betdagi 11-mashqning 1-bandiga o'xshash:
'It's too hot. I'LL OPEN the window.'
'an umbrella' = soyabon.

tasks.prompt: 18  Billy threw the ball ............ the swimming-pool.
tasks.whyUz:
'threw the ball INTO the pool' = to'pni havzaga tashladi.
INTO — IChKARIGA harakat.
throw → THREW (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'a swimming-pool' = suzish havzasi.

exercises.instructionEn: Tick (✓) the correct sentence, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri gapni belgilang, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAR BIR JUFTLIKDA BITTA GAP TO'G'RI, BITTASI XATO.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  a  Susie is going cycling in her free time.
     b  Susie goes cycling in her free time.   ✓

XATOLARNING TURLARI:

  1) ZAMON MOS EMAS
     'in her free time' → odat → PRESENT SIMPLE
     'at the moment' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS
     'last night' → PAST SIMPLE

  2) SO'ROQ ShAKLI XATO
     'Do you study at the moment?' ✗
     → 'Are you studying at the moment?' ✓

  3) FE'L ShAKLI XATO
     'you write' ✗  →  'you wrote' ✓

  4) OLMOSh XATO
     'is this hat your?' ✗  →  'yours?' ✓

  5) EGALIK APOSTROFI YO'Q
     'Jane book' ✗  →  "Jane's book" ✓

USUL: har juftlikda VAQT so'zini toping —
u ko'pincha javobni hal qiladi.

tasks.prompt: 1  a) Susie is going cycling in her free time.   b) Susie goes cycling in her free time.
tasks.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA — javob 'b'.
'in her free time' = bo'sh vaqtida → ODAT →
PRESENT SIMPLE ('goes').
'is going' hozirgi damni bildirardi — mos emas.
'go cycling' = velosipedda yurgani bormoq.

tasks.prompt: 2  a) Are you studying at the moment?   b) Do you study at the moment?
tasks.whyUz:
'at the moment' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS →
'ARE you STUDYING?'
'Do you study' — odat haqida bo'lardi,
'at the moment' bilan mos kelmaydi.

tasks.prompt: 3  a) She went to the theatre last night.   b) She goes to the theatre last night.
tasks.whyUz:
'last night' → PAST SIMPLE → 'WENT'.
'goes' — hozirgi zamon, 'last night' bilan mos kelmaydi.
go → WENT (noto'g'ri fe'l).

tasks.prompt: 4  a) What are you doing last Tuesday?   b) What did you do last Tuesday?
tasks.whyUz:
'last Tuesday' → PAST SIMPLE → 'DID you DO?'
'are you doing' — hozirgi damni bildiradi, mos emas.
DIQQAT: 'did' + 'do' — ikki marta 'do' TO'G'RI.

tasks.prompt: 5  a) When was the last time you write a letter?   b) When was the last time you wrote a letter?
tasks.whyUz:
'When WAS the last time ...' — o'tgan zamon.
Bu yerda 'did' YO'Q ('was' bor) →
asosiy fe'l O'TGAN shaklda → 'WROTE'.
Coursebook 74-betdagi 18-mashqda aynan shu qolip bor edi.

tasks.prompt: 6  a) I arrived last Wednesday.   b) I will arrive last Wednesday.
tasks.whyUz:
'last Wednesday' → O'TGAN zamon → 'ARRIVED'.
'will arrive' — KELASI zamon, 'last' bilan mos kelmaydi.
O'tgan vaqt bilan 'will' ishlatilmaydi.

tasks.prompt: 7  a) Did you have fun last night?   b) Do you have fun last night?
tasks.whyUz:
'last night' → PAST SIMPLE → 'DID you HAVE?'
'Do you have' — hozirgi zamon, mos kelmaydi.
50-betdagi 9-mashqda ham 'Did you have fun?' bor edi.

tasks.prompt: 8  a) Harriet is usually doing the cooking.   b) Harriet usually does the cooking.
tasks.whyUz:
'usually' → PRESENT SIMPLE → 'DOES'.
'Harriet' 3-shaxs BIRLIK → do + ES = DOES.
'is doing' — hozirgi damni bildiradi, 'usually' bilan
mos kelmaydi.
'do the cooking' = ovqat pishirmoq.

tasks.prompt: 9  a) Excuse me, is this hat yours?   b) Excuse me, is this hat your?
tasks.whyUz:
'YOURS' — EGALIK OLMOShI, ot KERAK EMAS.
'your' — EGALIK SIFATI, undan keyin OT kerak:
  'your hat' ✓  /  'is this hat your?' ✗
To'g'ri: 'Is this hat YOURS?' yoki 'Is this YOUR hat?'
Grammar 41-betdagi qoida.

tasks.prompt: 10  a) Jane's book is on the table.   b) Jane book is on the table.
tasks.whyUz:
"JANE'S book" — egalik APOSTROF + S bilan ko'rsatiladi.
'Jane book' XATO — ikki ot yonma-yon tura olmaydi.
DIQQAT: 'a bus stop', 'a park ranger' kabi
qo'shma otlarda apostrof kerak emas,
lekin ODAM egaligida SHART.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and tick. Listen again and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va belgilang. Yana tinglab takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI TOVUSH:

  /ʌ/ — qisqa 'a' tovushi.
        Og'iz biroz ochiq, til o'rtada.
        O'zbekchadagi 'A' ga yaqin, lekin qisqaroq.
        Odatda 'U' harfi bilan yoziladi:
           cut, sun, but, run, shut
        Ba'zan 'O' bilan ham:
           come, some, love, month

  /ɒ/ — qisqa 'o' tovushi.
        Lablar dumaloq, og'iz kengroq ochiq.
        O'zbekchadagi 'O' ga yaqin.
        Odatda 'O' harfi bilan yoziladi:
           hot, stop, shot, wrong, dog

TO'RT SO'Z BU MASHQDA:
  wrong  /rɒŋ/   → /ɒ/    (noto'g'ri)
  rung   /rʌŋ/   → /ʌ/    ('ring' ning 3-shakli)
  shut   /ʃʌt/   → /ʌ/    (yopmoq)
  shot   /ʃɒt/   → /ɒ/    ('shoot' ning o'tgan shakli)

DIQQAT — IKKI ENG MUHIM JUFTLIK:
  wrong /rɒŋ/  ↔  rung /rʌŋ/
  shot  /ʃɒt/  ↔  shut /ʃʌt/

  Faqat BITTA unli tovush farq qiladi,
  lekin ma'no BUTUNLAY boshqa.

DIQQAT — 'WRONG' YOZILIShI:
  Boshidagi 'W' O'QILMAYDI → /rɒŋ/.
  Shunga o'xshash: write /raɪt/, wrap /ræp/.

QO'ShIMChA JUFTLIKLAR (mashq uchun):
  cut /kʌt/    ↔  cot /kɒt/
  much /mʌtʃ/  ↔  watch /wɒtʃ/
  sun /sʌn/    ↔  son /sʌn/  (IKKALASI ham /ʌ/!)

tasks.whyUz:
/rɒŋ/ — qisqa 'o' tovushi → /ɒ/.
DIQQAT: boshidagi 'W' O'QILMAYDI.
'wrong' = noto'g'ri.

/rʌŋ/ — qisqa 'a' tovushi → /ʌ/.
'rung' — 'ring' fe'lining uchinchi shakli
(ring — rang — rung).
'wrong' bilan SOLISHTIRING: faqat unli farq qiladi.

/ʃʌt/ → /ʌ/.
'to shut' = yopmoq (= to close).
shut → SHUT (shakli O'ZGARMAYDI).

/ʃɒt/ → /ɒ/.
'shot' — 'shoot' (otmoq) fe'lining o'tgan shakli.
'shut' bilan SOLISHTIRING: faqat unli farq qiladi,
lekin ma'no butunlay boshqa.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the story, then try to fill in the gaps with adverbs from the list. Listen again and check your answers.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyani tinglang, so'ng bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi ravishlar bilan to'ldirishga harakat qiling. Yana tinglab javoblaringizni tekshiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta ravish, 8 ta bo'shliq):
  desperately, immediately, suddenly, carefully,
  quickly, tightly, sleepily, nervously

Har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA (a va b bandlarni beradi):
  'Tony SUDDENLY heard noises. First, he went SLEEPILY to
   the window. Next, ...'


DIQQAT — QAYSI JAVOB QANChALIK ANIQ:

  ANIQ BILINADI (kitobdagi namunadan):
     a  suddenly
     b  sleepily

  MA'NO JIHATDAN MAJBUR (boshqa variant mos kelmaydi):
     e  tightly      — 'closed the door TIGHTLY'
                       (boshqa ravish eshikka mos kelmaydi)
     f  desperately  — 'shouted DESPERATELY'
                       (77-betdagi hikoyada ham shunday)

  AUDIODAN ANIQLANADI:
     c, d, g, h — qolgan to'rt ravish (nervously,
     immediately, quickly, carefully) qaysi bo'shliqqa
     tushishini FAQAT audio hal qiladi.
     Quyida hikoya mantig'iga eng mos variant berilgan.


TO'LIQ HIKOYA (eng mos o'qilish bilan):

  a  Tony SUDDENLY heard noises.
  b  He went SLEEPILY to the window.
  c  He ran NERVOUSLY downstairs.
  d  He IMMEDIATELY rushed upstairs.
  e  He closed the door TIGHTLY.
  f  "Help!" he shouted DESPERATELY.
  g  He climbed QUICKLY onto a ladder.
  h  He climbed CAREFULLY down.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Toni to'satdan shovqin eshitdi. U uyqusirab deraza
  oldiga bordi. Asabiy holda pastga yugurdi. Darhol
  yuqoriga otildi. Eshikni mahkam yopdi. "Yordam bering!"
  — deb jon holatda qichqirdi. Tez narvonga chiqdi.
  Ehtiyotkorlik bilan pastga tushdi.


SO'NG VOQEALARNI BOG'LANG:
  first, next, after that, then, finally so'zlari bilan.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Tony suddenly heard noises. FIRST, he went sleepily to
   the window. NEXT, ...'

TO'LIQ BOG'LANGAN VARIANT:
  Tony suddenly heard noises. First, he went sleepily to
  the window. Next, he ran nervously downstairs. After
  that, he immediately rushed upstairs and closed the door
  tightly. Then, "Help!" he shouted desperately. Finally,
  he climbed quickly onto a ladder and climbed carefully
  down.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a noise      = shovqin
  downstairs   = pastga (zinadan)
  upstairs     = yuqoriga (zinadan)
  to rush      = otilmoq, shoshilmoq
  to climb     = chiqmoq, tirmashmoq
  a ladder     = narvon
  sleepily     = uyqusirab
  nervously    = asabiy holda

tasks.promptUz: Shovqin eshitgan odam qanday his qiladi?
tasks.whyUz:
AUDIODAN ANIQLANADI — bu yerda eng mos variant.
Asos: shovqin eshitib pastga yuguryapti —
hali nima bo'lganini bilmaydi, xavotirda →
NERVOUSLY (asabiy holda).
'nervous' + -ly → ravish.

AUDIODAN ANIQLANADI — bu yerda eng mos variant.
Asos: 'rush' (otilmoq) allaqachon tezlikni bildiradi,
shuning uchun 'quickly' takror bo'lardi.
'IMMEDIATELY rushed' = darhol otildi — tabiiy birikma.
DIQQAT: ravish bu yerda fe'ldan OLDIN turibdi.

MA'NO JIHATDAN MAJBUR — boshqa ravish eshikka mos
kelmaydi.
'closed the door TIGHTLY' = eshikni mahkam yopdi
(tutun kirmasligi uchun).
77-betdagi hikoyada ham: 'closed the car windows TIGHTLY'.

tasks.promptUz: Yordam so'rab qichqirgan odam qanday qichqiradi?
tasks.whyUz:
MA'NO JIHATDAN MAJBUR.
'shouted DESPERATELY' = jon holatda qichqirdi.
77-betdagi hikoyada ham: 'Claire screamed DESPERATELY'.
'desperate' + -ly → ravish.

tasks.prompt: g  He climbed ............ onto a ladder.
tasks.whyUz:
AUDIODAN ANIQLANADI — bu yerda eng mos variant.
Asos: uy yonyapti — narvonga TEZ chiqish kerak.
'a ladder' = narvon.
'climb ONTO' = ustiga chiqmoq.
tasks.speak: g  He climbed ............ onto a ladder.

tasks.whyUz:
AUDIODAN ANIQLANADI — bu yerda eng mos variant.
Asos: narvondan tushish XAVFLI, shuning uchun
EHTIYOTKORLIK bilan.
'careful' + -ly → carefully (78-betdagi namuna).
g-band bilan JUFT: tez chiqdi, ehtiyot bilan tushdi.

exercises.instructionEn: Now, link the events using first, next, after that, then and finally.
exercises.instructionUz: Endi voqealarni first, next, after that, then va finally so'zlari bilan bog'lang.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Tony suddenly heard noises. FIRST, he went sleepily to
  the window. NEXT, ...

BESH BOG'LOVCHI SO'Z (77-betdagi qoidadan):
  first      — birinchi
  next       — keyin
  after that — shundan keyin
  then       — so'ng
  finally    — nihoyat

TO'LIQ NAMUNA:

  Tony suddenly heard noises. First, he went sleepily to
  the window. Next, he ran nervously downstairs. After
  that, he immediately rushed upstairs and closed the door
  tightly. Then, "Help!" he shouted desperately. Finally,
  he climbed quickly onto a ladder and climbed carefully
  down.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Toni to'satdan shovqin eshitdi. Avval u uyqusirab deraza
  oldiga bordi. Keyin asabiy holda pastga yugurdi. Shundan
  keyin darhol yuqoriga otildi va eshikni mahkam yopdi.
  So'ng "Yordam bering!" — deb jon holatda qichqirdi.
  Nihoyat, tez narvonga chiqdi va ehtiyotkorlik bilan
  pastga tushdi.

DIQQAT — VERGUL:
  Bu so'zlar gap boshida kelganda keyin VERGUL qo'yiladi.

tasks.answer: First, he went sleepily to the window.
After that, he immediately rushed upstairs and closed the door tightly.
Finally, he climbed quickly onto a ladder and climbed carefully down.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the summary of the story and underline the correct words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoya xulosasini o'qing va qalin yozilgan to'g'ri so'zlarning tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ XULOSA (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Greg and Claire decided to go to Longleat Safari Park.
  FIRST, they drove into the park and Greg stopped the car.
  He took some pictures of the lions. AFTER THAT, he tried
  to start the car again. Suddenly, smoke began to come out
  of the engine. A few minutes later, the front of the car
  was on fire, so Claire beeped the horn and shouted for
  help. JUST THEN, a park ranger came along in his jeep to
  help them. FINALLY, another jeep arrived and chased the
  lions away. Greg and Claire felt very lucky to be alive.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Greg va Kler Longleat safari parkiga borishga qaror
  qilishdi. Avval ular parkka haydab kirishdi va Greg
  mashinani to'xtatdi. U sherlarni suratga oldi. Shundan
  keyin mashinani qaytadan yurgizmoqchi bo'ldi. To'satdan
  dvigateldan tutun chiqa boshladi. Bir necha daqiqadan
  keyin mashinaning old qismi yona boshladi, shuning uchun
  Kler signal chaldi va yordam so'rab qichqirdi. Shu payt
  jipda park qo'riqchisi ularga yordamga keldi. Nihoyat,
  yana bir jip yetib keldi va sherlarni quvib yubordi.
  Greg va Kler tirik qolganlari uchun juda omadli
  ekanlarini his qilishdi.

tasks.prompt: 1  First / Next, they drove into the park and Greg stopped the car.
tasks.whyUz:
Bu — xulosaning BIRINCHI voqeasi → FIRST.
'Next' oldingi voqeadan keyin kelganda ishlatiladi,
lekin bu yerda oldin hech narsa bo'lmagan
(faqat qaror qabul qilingan).

tasks.prompt: 2  Finally / After that, he tried to start the car again.
tasks.whyUz:
Hikoya HALI DAVOM ETADI → AFTER THAT.
'Finally' faqat ENG OXIRGI voqea uchun —
bu yerda hali yong'in, qutqaruv voqealari bor.

tasks.prompt: 3  When / Just then, a park ranger came along in his jeep to help them.
tasks.whyUz:
'JUST THEN' — kutilmagan voqea uchun RAVISH,
gap boshida mustaqil turadi.
'When' esa BOG'LOVChI — undan keyin ERGASH GAP kerak:
  'WHEN they were safe, they thanked him.'  ✓
  'WHEN, a park ranger came ...'            ✗ XATO
77-betdagi hikoyada ham aynan 'Just then' ishlatilgan.

tasks.prompt: 4  Finally / Last, another jeep arrived and chased the lions away.
tasks.whyUz:
'FINALLY' — eng oxirgi voqea uchun standart RAVISH.
'Last' — SIFAT yoki ravish, lekin gap boshida
voqealar ketma-ketligida ishlatilmaydi.
'At last' esa to'g'ri bo'lardi.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, look at the pictures on p. 76 and give a summary of the story. Use first, then, after that, etc where necessary.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng 76-betdagi rasmlarga qarang va hikoya xulosasini so'zlab bering. Kerak bo'lganda first, then, after that kabi so'zlardan foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
76-BETDAGI OLTI RASM BO'YICHA:

  A → sherlar orasidagi mashina
  B → dvigateldan tutun
  C → mashinaning oldi yonyapti
  D → mashina yonmoqda, sherlar atrofda
  E → jipga yugurish
  F → qutulish, xursandchilik

QOLIP:
  [ketma-ketlik so'zi], + [ega] + [o'tgan zamon fe'li] + ...

TO'LIQ NAMUNA (rasmlar bo'yicha):

  Last summer, Claire and Greg went to Longleat Safari
  Park. FIRST, they drove into the park and closed the car
  windows tightly. THEN, Greg stopped the car near some
  lions and took pictures of them. The lions roared loudly.
  AFTER THAT, Greg tried to start the car, but nothing
  happened. Smoke began to come out of the engine. A FEW
  MINUTES LATER, the front of the car was on fire. They
  couldn't get out because the lions were around the car.
  Claire beeped the horn and shouted for help. JUST THEN, a
  park ranger came along the road in his jeep. FINALLY,
  another jeep chased the lions away and Claire and Greg
  ran towards the jeep. IN THE END, they were safe. They
  were shocked but happy, and very lucky to be alive.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  O'tgan yozda Kler va Greg Longleat safari parkiga
  borishdi. Avval ular parkka haydab kirishdi va mashina
  oynalarini mahkam yopishdi. So'ng Greg mashinani
  sherlarga yaqin to'xtatdi va ularni suratga oldi.
  Sherlar baland ovozda bo'kirishdi. Shundan keyin Greg
  mashinani yurgizmoqchi bo'ldi, lekin hech narsa bo'lmadi.
  Dvigateldan tutun chiqa boshladi. Bir necha daqiqadan
  keyin mashinaning old qismi yona boshladi. Ular chiqa
  olmadilar, chunki sherlar mashina atrofida edi. Kler
  signal chaldi va yordam so'rab qichqirdi. Shu payt yo'l
  bo'ylab jipda park qo'riqchisi keldi. Nihoyat, yana bir
  jip sherlarni quvib yubordi va Kler bilan Greg jip tomon
  yugurishdi. Oxir-oqibat ular xavfsiz bo'lishdi. Sarosimada,
  lekin xursand edilar va tirik qolganlari uchun juda
  omadli edilar.

First, they drove into the park and closed the car windows tightly. Then, Greg stopped the car near some lions and took pictures of them.
After that, Greg tried to start the car, but nothing happened. Smoke began to come out of the engine.

sections.title: Communication — Reporting Emergencies
sections.titleUz: Muloqot — Favqulodda hodisa haqida xabar berish

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the dialogue. Then, in pairs, read the dialogue aloud.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni tinglang. So'ng juftlikda dialogni ovoz chiqarib o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ DIALOG:

  O: Emergency services ... Which service do you require,
     please?
  A: POLICE, please.
  B: HILL STREET POLICE STATION ... Can I help you?
  A: I want to report A BREAK-IN at my house. Please come
     quickly!
  B: Could you give me your address and telephone number,
     please?
  A: Yes — it's 5, BOND ROAD and my telephone number is
     9834758.
  B: And your name, please?
  A: JACK ROSS.
  B: Thank you, MR ROSS. There's A POLICE CAR on the way now.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  O: Favqulodda xizmatlar... Qaysi xizmat kerak?
  A: Militsiya, iltimos.
  B: Hill Street militsiya bo'limi... Yordam bera olamanmi?
  A: Uyimga o'g'rilik bo'lgani haqida xabar bermoqchiman.
     Iltimos, tezroq keling!
  B: Manzilingiz va telefon raqamingizni ayta olasizmi?
  A: Ha — 5, Bond Road, telefon raqamim 9834758.
  B: Ismingiz-chi?
  A: Jek Ross.
  B: Rahmat, janob Ross. Hozir militsiya mashinasi
     yo'lda.


DIALOG TUZILISHI (5 bosqich):
  1) Operator QAYSI XIZMAT kerakligini so'raydi
  2) Chaqiruvchi xizmatni aytadi
  3) Chaqiruvchi MUAMMONI aytadi
  4) Operator MANZIL va TELEFON so'raydi
  5) Operator ISM so'raydi va yordam yuborilganini aytadi

UCH FAVQULODDA XIZMAT:
  POLICE       — militsiya
  FIRE BRIGADE — o't o'chirish xizmati
  AMBULANCE    — tez yordam

Britaniyada favqulodda raqam: 999
AQShda: 911
O'zbekistonda: 101, 102, 103

MUHIM IBORALAR:
  Which service do you require?
     = Qaysi xizmat kerak?
  I want to report ...
     = ...haqida xabar bermoqchiman.
  Please come quickly!
     = Iltimos, tezroq keling!
  Could you give me your address, please?
     = Manzilingizni ayta olasizmi?
  There's a ... on the way now.
     = Hozir ... yo'lda.

DIQQAT — 'COULD YOU ...?':
  'Can you ...?' dan MULOYIMROQ.
Rasmiy suhbatda 'could' ishlatiladi.

DIQQAT — TELEFON RAQAMI O'QILISHI:
  9834758 → 'nine eight three four seven five eight'
  Raqamlar BITTALAB o'qiladi.
  '0' → 'oh' yoki 'zero' deb o'qiladi.
  Ikki bir xil raqam ketma-ket bo'lsa: '77' → 'double seven'.

DIQQAT — MANZIL:
  '5, Bond Road' — avval UY RAQAMI, keyin KO'ChA nomi.
  O'zbekchada teskari: Bond ko'chasi, 5-uy.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  emergency services = favqulodda xizmatlar
  to require   = talab qilmoq, kerak bo'lmoq
  to report    = xabar bermoq
  a break-in   = o'g'rilik (uyga bostirib kirish)
  on the way   = yo'lda

exercises.instructionEn: When we start a story ... we write when and where the event happened, who the people in the story were and what happened first.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA — HIKOYANI BOSHLASH:

  Hikoya boshlanishida TO'RT narsa bo'lishi kerak:

  1) WHEN  — voqea QAChON sodir bo'ldi
  2) WHERE — QAYERDA sodir bo'ldi
  3) WHO   — hikoyadagi odamlar KIM edi
  4) WHAT  — avval NIMA bo'ldi

77-BETDAGI HIKOYA HAM SHUNDAY BOSHLANGAN:
  'One gorgeous, sunny day LAST SUMMER (WHEN), CLAIRE and
   her friend GREG (WHO) went to LONGLEAT SAFARI PARK
   (WHERE).'

FOYDALI BOSHLANISH QOLIPLARI:
  One gorgeous, sunny day last summer, ...
  That cold winter afternoon, ...
  It was a lovely day, so ...
  Last Saturday morning, ...

DIQQAT — SIFATLAR QO'ShING:
  78-betdagi qoidani eslang:
  'One day' o'rniga 'One BEAUTIFUL SUNNY day' —
  sifatlar hikoyani qiziqarli qiladi.

exercises.instructionUz: Rasmga qarang va qisqa matnni o'qing. So'ng savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN:
  That cold winter afternoon, I decided to take my dog,
  Rex, for a walk on the beach. Suddenly, Rex began to
  bark loudly.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  O'sha sovuq qish kunining tushdan keyingi payti men itim
  Reksni plyajda sayr qildirishga qaror qildim. To'satdan
  Reks baland ovozda hura boshladi.

RASMDA: qish kiyimidagi odam plyajda iti bilan yuribdi.

BU MATN — HIKOYA BOSHLANISHIGA NAMUNA.
Unda to'rtala savolning javobi ham bor:
  WHEN  → That cold winter afternoon
  WHERE → on the beach
  WHO   → I and my dog, Rex
  WHAT  → Rex began to bark loudly

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an afternoon = tushdan keyingi payt
  to take a dog for a walk = itni sayr qildirmoq
  the beach    = plyaj, qirg'oq
  to bark      = hurmoq (it haqida)

tasks.answer: It happened that cold winter afternoon.
tasks.whyUz:
Matnda: 'THAT COLD WINTER AFTERNOON'.
Hikoya boshlanishining BIRINCHI qismi — VAQT.
DIQQAT: 'cold' va 'winter' — sifatlar, matnni
qiziqarliroq qiladi.

Matnda: 'for a walk ON THE BEACH'.
Hikoya boshlanishining IKKINCHI qismi — JOY.
'ON the beach' — predlog ON.

tasks.answer: The writer (I) and his/her dog, Rex, were there.
tasks.whyUz:
Matnda: 'I decided to take MY DOG, REX, for a walk'.
Hikoya boshlanishining UChINChI qismi — ODAMLAR.
Hikoya BIRINChI shaxsda ('I') yozilgan.

tasks.answer: Suddenly, Rex began to bark loudly.
tasks.whyUz:
Matnda: 'SUDDENLY, Rex BEGAN TO BARK LOUDLY.'
Hikoya boshlanishining TO'RTINChI qismi — birinchi voqea.
'Suddenly' — hikoyada burilish nuqtasi.
'loudly' — ravish (78-betdagi qoida).

exercises.instructionEn: When we end a story ... we write what happened in the end and how the people in the story felt.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyani tugatganimizda oxirida nima bo'lganini va hikoyadagi odamlar o'zini qanday his qilganini yozamiz.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA — HIKOYANI TUGATISH:

  Hikoya oxirida IKKI narsa bo'lishi kerak:

  1) WHAT happened IN THE END — oxirida nima bo'ldi
  2) HOW the people FELT       — ular o'zini qanday his qildi

77-BETDAGI HIKOYA HAM SHUNDAY TUGAGAN:
  'When they were safe inside the jeep, they thanked the
   park ranger for his help. (NIMA BO'LDI)
   They were still shocked, but happy. They knew they were
   very lucky to be alive. (QANDAY HIS QILDILAR)'

HIS-TUYG'U SIFATLARI:

  IJOBIY (positive):
     happy      xursand
     proud      faxrlanuvchi
     relieved   yengil tortgan
     excited    hayajonlangan
     lucky      omadli

  SALBIY (negative):
     upset      xafa
     sad        g'amgin
     scared     qo'rqqan
     shocked    sarosimada
     angry      jahli chiqqan
     disappointed umidi puchga chiqqan

FOYDALI TUGATISH QOLIPLARI:
  In the end, ...
  Finally, ...
  They felt very ... .
  It was a(n) ... experience!
  They knew they were very lucky to ... .
