exercises.instructionUz: Hikoya tugallanmalarini o'qing va har bir odamning his-tuyg'usini ko'rsatadigan sifatlarning tagiga chizing. Qaysilari ijobiy? Qaysilari salbiy?
exercises.explanationUz:
UCH TUGALLANMA — har birida BITTA his-tuyg'u sifati.

USUL:
  1) His-tuyg'uni bildiruvchi sifatni toping
  2) U IJOBIYmi yoki SALBIYmi — aniqlang

BELGILAR:
  'felt/was + SIFAT' qolipini qidiring
     I FELT very HAPPY
     Pam WAS really UPSET
     He FELT PROUD

DIQQAT — 'TO BE' va 'TO FEEL' IKKALASI HAM ISHLATILADI:
  I felt happy.  =  I was happy.
  Ma'no bir xil.

tasks.prompt: 1  I felt very ............ to be the winner of the competition.  (sifat qaysi? ijobiymi yoki salbiy?)
tasks.promptUz: G'olib bo'lgan odam nima his qiladi?
tasks.whyUz:
Sifat: HAPPY (xursand) → IJOBIY.
'to be the winner' = g'olib bo'lmoq.
'a competition' = musobaqa.
G'alaba — ijobiy voqea, shuning uchun his-tuyg'u ham ijobiy.
tasks.speak: 1  I felt very ............ to be the winner of the competition.  (sifat qaysi? ijobiymi yoki salbiy?)

tasks.prompt: 2  Pam was really ............ to see him leave.  (sifat qaysi? ijobiymi yoki salbiy?)
tasks.whyUz:
Sifat: UPSET (xafa) → SALBIY.
'upset' = xafa, ranjigan.
'to see him leave' = uning ketishini ko'rmoq.
Ajralish — salbiy voqea.
tasks.speak: 2  Pam was really ............ to see him leave.  (sifat qaysi? ijobiymi yoki salbiy?)

tasks.prompt: 3  He felt ............ with the gold cup in his hands.  (sifat qaysi? ijobiymi yoki salbiy?)
tasks.promptUz: Oltin kubok qo'lida bo'lgan odam nima his qiladi?
tasks.whyUz:
Sifat: PROUD (faxrlanuvchi) → IJOBIY.
'proud' = faxrlanadigan, g'ururlanadigan.
'a gold cup' = oltin kubok (mukofot).
1-band bilan bir xil vaziyat — g'alaba.

exercises.explanationUz:
DIQQAT — RASMLAR BOShQA JOYDA:
  Bu mashq kitobning OXIRIDAGI 'Photo File' bo'limidagi
  rasmlarga tayanadi. O'sha rasmlar bu betda YO'Q,
  shuning uchun bu yerda aniq hikoya TO'QIB yozilmadi.

  Quyida bu betdagi IKKI QUTIDAN kelib chiqadigan
  TUZILISH va QOLIPLAR berilgan — ular istalgan
  rasm to'plamiga mos keladi.


BOShLANISh — TO'RT SAVOLGA JAVOB BERING:

  WHEN  — Qachon?
     One gorgeous, sunny day last summer, ...
     That cold winter afternoon, ...
     Last Saturday morning, ...

  WHERE — Qayerda?
     ... at the beach / in the park / in the countryside

  WHO   — Kim?
     ... my friend Tom and I ...
     ... Claire and her friend Greg ...

  WHAT  — Avval nima bo'ldi?
     ... we decided to go for a walk.
     ... Suddenly, ...


TUGALLANMA — IKKI NARSANI YOZING:

  1) OXIRIDA NIMA BO'LDI
     In the end, ...
     Finally, ...

  2) ULAR QANDAY HIS QILDI
     We felt very happy / relieved / lucky.
     It was a horrible / wonderful experience!
     We knew we were very lucky to ... .


NAMUNA BOSHLANISh (78-betdagi Ralf hikoyasi uchun):
  It was a lovely spring morning, so Ralph decided to go
  for a ride in the countryside. He got on his horse and
  rode out of the field. At first, everything was fine.

NAMUNA TUGALLANMA (o'sha hikoya uchun):
  In the end, Ralph got out of the lake and walked home
  with his horse. He was cold and very wet, and he felt
  really embarrassed. It was a horrible experience!


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  BOShLANISh: Bahorning ajoyib tongi edi, shuning uchun
  Ralf qishloqqa ot mingani borishga qaror qildi. U otiga
  mindi va daladan chiqib ketdi. Dastlab hammasi yaxshi edi.

  TUGALLANMA: Oxir-oqibat Ralf ko'ldan chiqdi va oti bilan
  uyiga piyoda qaytdi. U sovqotgan va juda ho'l edi,
  o'zini juda uyalgan his qilardi. Bu dahshatli tajriba edi!


DIQQAT — HIKOYADA QANDAY VOSITALAR ISHLATILADI:
  • SIFATLAR (78-bet)     — hikoyani qiziqarli qiladi
  • RAVIShLAR (79-bet)    — harakatni aniq tasvirlaydi
  • KETMA-KETLIK so'zlari (77-bet) — first, then, suddenly
  • BOG'LOVChILAR (79-bet) — and, but, because, so, when
  • HARAKAT PREDLOGLARI (78-bet) — along, through, into

tasks.answer: One gorgeous, sunny day last summer, we went to the beach.
My friend Tom and I decided to spend the day there.
At first, everything was fine. Suddenly, we heard a strange noise.
In the end, a park ranger came and helped us.
We were still shocked, but happy. We knew we were very lucky. It was an experience we will never forget!

exercises.instructionEn: When we write a story ...
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoya yozganimizda ...
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA — TO'LIQ HIKOYA TUZILISHI:

  Hikoya yozganimizda voqea QAChON va QAYERDA sodir
  bo'lganini, hikoyadagi odamlar KIM ekanini va avval NIMA
  bo'lganini aytish bilan BOShLAYMIZ.

  So'ng ASOSIY VOQEADAN OLDIN nima bo'lganini yozib DAVOM
  ETTIRAMIZ (2-xatboshi), keyin hikoyaning ASOSIY
  VOQEASINI tasvirlaymiz (3-xatboshi).

  Hikoyani OXIRIDA nima bo'lgani va odamlar o'zini QANDAY
  HIS QILGANINI yozib TUGATAMIZ.

  Hikoya aytganimizda O'TGAN ZAMONLARNI ishlatamiz.


TO'RT XATBOSHI — REJA:

  1-XATBOShI: hikoyani BOShLASh
     • odamlar kim edi (WHO)
     • qachon / qayerda / nima bo'ldi (WHEN/WHERE/WHAT)

  2-3-XATBOShI: hikoyani RIVOJLANTIRISh
     • asosiy voqeadan OLDIN nima bo'ldi
     • ASOSIY VOQEANING o'zi

  4-XATBOShI: hikoyani TUGATISh
     • oxirida nima bo'ldi
     • u o'zini qanday his qildi


79-BETDAGI QOIDA BILAN SOLIShTIRING:
  79-betda faqat BOShLANISh va TUGALLANMA berilgan edi.
  Bu yerda O'RTA qism (2-3-xatboshi) ham qo'shilgan —
  demak bu TO'LIQ tuzilish.


HIKOYADA ISHLATILADIGAN VOSITALAR (11-unitdan):
  • O'TGAN ZAMON             — was, went, saw, heard
  • SIFATLAR (78-bet)        — gorgeous, scary, brave
  • RAVIShLAR (79-bet)       — suddenly, desperately
  • KETMA-KETLIK (77-bet)    — first, then, finally
  • BOG'LOVChILAR (79-bet)   — and, but, because, so, when
  • HARAKAT PREDLOGLARI (78-bet) — into, through, over

exercises.instructionEn: Use the pictures below and the events from Ex. 21 to write a story (100 - 150 words) for a magazine. End your story with ... After all, he was very lucky to be alive!
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi rasmlardan va 21-mashqdagi voqealardan foydalanib jurnal uchun hikoya (100-150 so'z) yozing. Hikoyangizni shu bilan tugating: ... After all, he was very lucky to be alive!
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI RASM:
  1-rasm — Uy yonmoqda. Derazadagi odam 'Help!' deb
           qichqiryapti. O't o'chiruvchi shlang bilan
           suv sepyapti.
  2-rasm — O't o'chiruvchi narvonda: 'Don't panic!
           I'll help you.' Odam narvondan tushyapti.

KITOB BERGAN TUGASH GAPI:
  ... After all, he was very lucky to be alive!
  ('After all' = axir, oxir-oqibat)


REJA (kitobdagi):
  Para 1:  hikoyani boshlash
           (odamlar kim edi, qachon/qayerda/nima bo'ldi)
     ↓
  Para 2-3: hikoyani rivojlantirish
           (asosiy voqeadan oldin nima bo'ldi / asosiy voqea)
     ↓
  Para 4:  hikoyani tugatish
           (oxirida nima bo'ldi — u qanday his qildi)


TO'LIQ NAMUNA HIKOYA (130 so'z):

  One cold winter night, Tony was asleep in his house in
  London. Suddenly, he heard noises. First, he went
  sleepily to the window, but he couldn't see anything.
  Next, he ran nervously downstairs.

  When he got to the kitchen, he saw smoke and flames
  everywhere. The house was on fire! He immediately rushed
  upstairs to his bedroom and closed the door tightly, so
  the smoke could not come in.

  Tony opened the window. "Help!" he shouted desperately. A
  few minutes later, a fire engine arrived and a
  firefighter put a ladder against the wall. "Don't panic!
  I'll help you," he shouted. Tony climbed quickly onto the
  ladder and then climbed carefully down.

  In the end, the firefighters put out the fire. Tony was
  shocked and very tired, but he felt safe. After all, he
  was very lucky to be alive!


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:

  Bir sovuq qish kechasi Toni Londondagi uyida uxlab
  yotgan edi. To'satdan u shovqin eshitdi. Avval uyqusirab
  deraza oldiga bordi, lekin hech narsa ko'ra olmadi.
  Keyin asabiy holda pastga yugurdi.

  Oshxonaga yetganida hamma yerda tutun va olovni ko'rdi.
  Uy yonayotgan edi! U darhol yuqoriga, yotoqxonasiga
  otildi va eshikni mahkam yopdi — tutun kirmasligi uchun.

  Toni derazani ochdi. "Yordam bering!" — deb jon holatda
  qichqirdi. Bir necha daqiqadan keyin o't o'chirish
  mashinasi keldi va o't o'chiruvchi devorga narvon qo'ydi.
  "Vahima qilmang! Men sizga yordam beraman," — deb
  qichqirdi u. Toni tez narvonga chiqdi va ehtiyotkorlik
  bilan pastga tushdi.

  Oxir-oqibat o't o'chiruvchilar yong'inni o'chirishdi.
  Toni sarosimada va juda charchagan edi, lekin o'zini
  xavfsiz his qildi. Axir, u tirik qolgani uchun juda
  omadli edi!


DIQQAT — SO'Z SONI:
  Kitob 100-150 so'z so'raydi.
  Yuqoridagi namuna — 130 so'z.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a flame        = alanga
  a firefighter  = o't o'chiruvchi
  a ladder       = narvon
  to put a ladder against = narvon qo'ymoq
  Don't panic!   = Vahima qilmang!
  to put out a fire = yong'inni o'chirmoq
  After all      = axir, oxir-oqibat

tasks.answer: One cold winter night, Tony was asleep in his house in London. Suddenly, he heard noises. First, he went sleepily to the window, but he couldn't see anything. Next, he ran nervously downstairs.
When he got to the kitchen, he saw smoke and flames everywhere. The house was on fire! He immediately rushed upstairs to his bedroom and closed the door tightly, so the smoke could not come in.

Tony opened the window. "Help!" he shouted desperately. A few minutes later, a fire engine arrived and a firefighter put a ladder against the wall. "Don't panic! I'll help you," he shouted. Tony climbed quickly onto the ladder and then climbed carefully down.

tasks.note:

BU — UNITNING NOMI.

UNIT MISOLLARI:
  Kler va Greg — mashina yondi, sherlar o'rab oldi,

sentencePatterns.formula: How DO/DOES + ega + LOOK / FEEL?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How do the lions look? — Scary. How do the people feel? — Scared.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sherlar qanday ko'rinadi? — Qo'rqinchli. Odamlar o'zini qanday his qiladi? — Qo'rqqan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'look' — tashqi ko'rinish (SCARY);
'feel' — ichki holat (SCARED).

sentencePatterns.formula: The car IS ON FIRE.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The front of the car is on fire.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mashinaning old qismi yonyapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'on fire' = yonayotgan — o'zgarmas ibora.

sentencePatterns.formula: Smoke IS COMING OUT OF the engine.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What is coming out of the engine? — Smoke.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Dvigateldan nima chiqyapti? — Tutun.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'come out of' = ...dan chiqmoq.
'smoke' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot.

sentencePatterns.formula: "..." + ism + SAID / LAUGHED / SCREAMED.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: "We don't want to be a lion's lunch," Claire laughed.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: "Sherning tushligi bo'lishni xohlamaymiz," — kuldi Kler.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
To'g'ri nutqda gapiruvchi qo'shtirnoqdan KEYIN keladi.
Gapirish fe'llari: said, laughed, screamed, shouted.

sentencePatterns.formula: LET'S GO AND + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Let's go and see the gorillas, now.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kelinglar, endi gorillalarni ko'ramiz.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'Let's go AND see' — ikki fe'l 'and' bilan.
Taklif bildiradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: HOLD ON, we'll GET you OUT!
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Hold on, we'll get you out!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Chidang, sizni chiqarib olamiz!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'Hold on!' = chidang! kuting!
'get somebody out' = kimnidir chiqarib olmoq.
'we'll' — kelasi zamon.

sentencePatterns.formula: ONE + sifat + DAY + vaqt, + ega + o'tgan fe'l + ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: One gorgeous, sunny day last summer, Claire and her friend Greg went to Longleat Safari Park.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'tgan yozning ajoyib, quyoshli kunlaridan birida Kler va do'sti Greg safari parkiga borishdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
HIKOYANI BOSHLASH qolipi:
QAChON + KIM + QAYERGA.

sentencePatterns.formula: "..." + ism + SAID / LAUGHED / SCREAMED / SHOUTED.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: "We'll burn alive!" Claire screamed desperately.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: "Tiriklayin yonamiz!" — deb jon holatda qichqirdi Kler.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
To'g'ri nutqda gapiruvchi qo'shtirnoqdan KEYIN.
Gapirish fe'li ravish bilan kelishi mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: SUDDENLY, + ega + BEGAN TO + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Suddenly, smoke began to come out of the engine.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: To'satdan dvigateldan tutun chiqa boshladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'Suddenly' — hikoyada BURILISh nuqtasini bildiradi.
'begin TO + fe'l' = ...ni boshlamoq.

sentencePatterns.formula: They WANTED TO + fe'l, BUT they COULDN'T BECAUSE + sabab.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They wanted to jump out of the car, but they couldn't because the lions were around it.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular mashinadan sakrab chiqmoqchi bo'lishdi, lekin chiqolmadilar, chunki sherlar atrofda edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Bir gapda IKKI bog'lovchi:
'but' — qarama-qarshilik;  'because' — sabab.

sentencePatterns.formula: JUST THEN, + ega + o'tgan fe'l + ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Just then, a park ranger came along the road in his jeep.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shu payt yo'l bo'ylab jipda park qo'riqchisi keldi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'Just then' — KUTILMAGAN voqea, gap boshida + vergul.

sentencePatterns.formula: They THANKED + kim + FOR + nima.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They thanked the park ranger for his help.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular park qo'riqchisiga yordami uchun rahmat aytishdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'thank somebody FOR something' — 'for' SHART.

sentencePatterns.formula: They were LUCKY TO BE alive.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They knew they were very lucky to be alive.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tirik qolganlari uchun juda omadli ekanlarini bilishardi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'lucky TO + fe'l' = ...qilgani uchun omadli.
Hikoyani his-tuyg'u bilan tugatish qolipi.

sentencePatterns.formula: He went ALONG / THROUGH / ACROSS / PAST / UNDER / OVER + joy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He went along the road, through the tunnel and towards the forest.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U yo'l bo'ylab, tunnel ichidan o'tib, o'rmon tomon bordi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Harakat predloglari yo'nalishni aniq ko'rsatadi.
Bir gapda bir nechtasi 'and' bilan bog'lanishi mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: He went UP the hill ... and DOWN the other side.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Then, he went up the hill. After that, he went down the other side of the hill.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: So'ng tepalikka chiqdi. Shundan keyin tepalikning narigi tomonidan tushdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'up' va 'down' — aks juftlik.
'the other side' = narigi tomon.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + JUMPED OVER + narsa.   /   Ega + FELL OFF + narsa AND INTO + joy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It jumped over the fence. Ralph fell off the horse and into the lake.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U panjara ustidan sakradi. Ralf otdan yiqilib ko'lga tushdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'jump OVER' = ustidan sakramoq.
'fall OFF' = ustidan yiqilmoq;  'fall INTO' = ichiga tushmoq.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + IS + A/AN + SIFAT + OT.   ↔   Ega + FE'L + RAVISH.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He is a careful driver. He drives carefully.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U ehtiyotkor haydovchi. U ehtiyotkorlik bilan haydaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
SIFAT otni aniqlaydi (What kind of ...?).
RAVISH fe'lni aniqlaydi (How ...?).

sentencePatterns.formula: ONE + sifat + sifat + DAY + vaqt, + ega + fe'l ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: One beautiful sunny day last summer, they went to the park.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'tgan yozning go'zal, quyoshli kunida ular bog'ga borishdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Sifatlar hikoyani QIZIQARLIROQ qiladi.
Ikki sifat vergul bilan ajratiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: She saw AN OLD man WITH + tashqi belgi.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She saw an old man with white hair and blue eyes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U oq sochli va ko'k ko'zli keksa odamni ko'rdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'with' — tashqi ko'rinishni tasvirlash uchun.
'AN old' — 'o' unli tovush → AN.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + FE'L + RAVISH.   (How ...?)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The child smiled happily. She could run very fast. They sang very well.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bola baxtli jilmaydi. U juda tez yugura olardi. Ular juda yaxshi kuylashdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
RAVISH fe'ldan KEYIN turadi.
'good' ning ravishi — WELL.

sentencePatterns.formula: SABAB + , SO + NATIJA.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The door was not locked, so Mike opened it and went inside.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Eshik qulflanmagan edi, shuning uchun Mayk uni ochdi va ichkariga kirdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'so' oldidan VERGUL.
Avval sabab, keyin natija.

sentencePatterns.formula: NATIJA + BECAUSE + SABAB.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Mandy felt nervous because the dog looked very scary.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mendi asabiylashdi, chunki it juda qo'rqinchli ko'rinardi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'because' — 'so' ning TESKARISI.
Avval natija, keyin sabab.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + WAS/WERE + joy + WHEN + voqea.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Liz was in the kitchen when the phone rang. He was in bed when he heard a strange noise.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Liz oshxonada edi, o'shanda telefon jiringladi. U to'shakda edi, o'shanda g'alati shovqin eshitdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'when' — davom etayotgan holat va TO'SATDAN bo'lgan
voqeani bog'laydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: THAT + sifat + sifat + vaqt, + ega + fe'l ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: That cold winter afternoon, I decided to take my dog for a walk on the beach.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'sha sovuq qish kunining tushdan keyingi payti itimni plyajda sayr qildirishga qaror qildim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
HIKOYA BOSHLASH qolipi: WHEN + WHO + WHERE.
Sifatlar qo'shing.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + FELT / WAS + his-tuyg'u sifati.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I felt very happy to be the winner. Pam was really upset. He felt proud.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: G'olib bo'lganimdan juda xursand edim. Pam juda xafa edi. U faxrlanardi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
HIKOYA TUGATISH qolipi.
'felt' va 'was' — ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.

sentencePatterns.formula: MANY YEARS AGO IN + joy, THERE LIVED + ega.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Many years ago in Haarlem, Holland, there lived a young boy.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ko'p yillar oldin Gollandiyaning Xarlem shahrida bir yosh bola yashardi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'THERE LIVED ...' — ertak va afsonalarga xos ADABIY tartib.
Odatdagisi: 'A young boy lived ...'

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + FELT + his-tuyg'u sifati + BECAUSE + sabab.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Hans felt frightened because he knew what could happen.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hans qo'rqib ketdi, chunki nima bo'lishi mumkinligini bilardi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'feel + sifat' = ...his qilmoq.
'because' — sabab bog'lovchisi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + COULD + fe'l ... , SO + natija.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He put his finger in the hole, so no more water could come through it.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U barmog'ini teshikka tiqdi, shu bilan suv boshqa o'tolmadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'so' — NATIJA bog'lovchisi (79-bet).
'could' — 9-unitdagi o'tgan zamon qobiliyati.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + COULD GET + qiyosiy daraja + AND + qiyosiy daraja.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The small hole could get bigger and bigger.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kichkina teshik tobora kattalashib borishi mumkin edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Qiyosiy daraja IKKI marta takrorlanadi —
asta-sekin o'zgarishni bildiradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: [savol so'zi] + DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?   →   ega + O'TGAN fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where did Hans live? — He lived in Haarlem, Holland.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hans qayerda yashardi? — U Gollandiyaning Xarlem shahrida yashardi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Savolda ASOSIY shakl, javobda O'TGAN shakl.
LEKIN 'be' fe'li bilan: 'How old WAS Hans?' ('did' yo'q).

sentencePatterns.formula: Everyone WAS very PROUD OF + kim.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Everyone was very proud of that brave little boy!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hamma o'sha jasur kichkina bolani juda faxr bilan eslardi!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'proud OF' — 'of' SHART.
Hikoya tugallanmasi: his-tuyg'u bilan tugaydi (79-bet).

sentencePatterns.formula: I WANT TO REPORT + muammo + AT my house.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I want to report a break-in at my house. Please come quickly!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uyimga o'g'rilik bo'lgani haqida xabar bermoqchiman. Iltimos, tezroq keling!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Favqulodda xizmatga muammoni bildirish qolipi.
'report a fire / an accident / a break-in'.

sentencePatterns.formula: COULD YOU give me your + ma'lumot + , PLEASE?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Could you give me your address and telephone number, please?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Manzilingiz va telefon raqamingizni ayta olasizmi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'Could you ...?' — 'Can you' dan MULOYIMROQ.
Rasmiy suhbatda ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: There's A + transport + ON THE WAY now.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There's a police car on the way now.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hozir militsiya mashinasi yo'lda.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'on the way' = yo'lda, kelayotgan.
Operatorning tinchlantiruvchi javobi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + RAVISH + FE'L.   /   Ega + FE'L + RAVISH.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Tony suddenly heard noises. He shouted desperately.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Toni to'satdan shovqin eshitdi. U jon holatda qichqirdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ravish fe'ldan OLDIN ham, KEYIN ham kelishi mumkin.
'suddenly' odatda oldin, tarz ravishlari odatda keyin.

sentencePatterns.formula: FIRST, ... NEXT, ... AFTER THAT, ... THEN, ... FINALLY, ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: First, he went sleepily to the window. Next, he ran nervously downstairs.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Avval u uyqusirab deraza oldiga bordi. Keyin asabiy holda pastga yugurdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ketma-ketlik so'zlari gap boshida + VERGUL.

sentencePatterns.formula: AFTER ALL, he was very LUCKY TO BE alive!
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: After all, he was very lucky to be alive!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Axir, u tirik qolgani uchun juda omadli edi!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Kitob bergan TUGASH gapi.
'After all' = axir, oxir-oqibat.
'lucky TO BE alive' — 77-betda ham bor edi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Look at THIS + sifat + ot.   ↔   Look at THESE + sifat + otlar.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Look at this tall tree. Look at these tall trees.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu baland daraxtga qarang. Bu baland daraxtlarga qarang.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: SIFAT o'zgarmaydi ('tall'), faqat OLMOSh va OT o'zgaradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + FE'L + RAVISH.   (How ...?)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He drives carefully.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U ehtiyotkorlik bilan haydaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
RAVISH fe'lni aniqlaydi.
SIFAT: 'He is a CAREFUL driver.'

sentencePatterns.formula: 1-gap + AND + 2-gap (ega tushadi).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He locked the door and left the house.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U eshikni qulfladi va uydan chiqdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ega BIR XIL bo'lsa, ikkinchisida tushirib qoldiriladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: NATIJA + BECAUSE + SABAB.   ↔   SABAB + , SO + NATIJA.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Julie was happy because she didn't have any homework. I was very tired, so I decided to go to bed.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Juli xursand edi, chunki uy vazifasi yo'q edi. Juda charchagan edim, shuning uchun yotishga qaror qildim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ma'no bir xil, TARTIB teskari.
'so' oldidan VERGUL, 'because' oldidan yo'q.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + WAS/WERE + holat + WHEN + to'satdan bo'lgan voqea.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He was at work when he heard the news.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U ishda edi, o'shanda xabarni eshitdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'when' — davom etayotgan holat va to'satdan bo'lgan
voqeani bog'laydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + fe'l + PAST / TOWARDS / ACROSS / ALONG / UP / DOWN / UNDER / INTO / OVER / THROUGH + joy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He walked past the postbox. He jumped over the wall. The train went through the tunnel.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U pochta qutisi yonidan o'tdi. U devor ustidan sakradi. Poyezd tunnel ichidan o'tdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Harakat predloglari yo'nalishni ANIQ ko'rsatadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + FE'L + RAVISh.   ↔   Ega + IS/WAS + SIFAT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: John dressed quickly. You are very lucky.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jon tez kiyindi. Siz juda omadlisiz.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Fe'lni aniqlasa → RAVISh.
'to be' dan keyin → SIFAT.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + LOOKED / FELT / SEEMED + SIFAT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She looked beautiful on her wedding day.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U to'y kuni go'zal ko'rinardi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
ENG MUHIM ISTISNO:
'look', 'feel', 'seem' dan keyin RAVISh EMAS, SIFAT keladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: 1-gap + , SO + natija.   ↔   1-gap + BECAUSE + sabab.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Sally was tired, so she decided to go to bed. She felt nervous because she was alone.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Salli charchagan edi, shuning uchun yotishga qaror qildi. U asabiylashdi, chunki yolg'iz edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'so' — SABAB + so + NATIJA;
'because' — NATIJA + because + SABAB.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + WAS + holat + WHEN + to'satdan bo'lgan voqea.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She was asleep when the telephone rang. I was in bed when I heard a strange noise.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U uxlab yotgan edi, o'shanda telefon jiringladi. Men to'shakda edim, o'shanda g'alati shovqin eshitdim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'when' — davom etayotgan holatni va to'satdan bo'lgan
voqeani bog'laydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + fe'l + AND + fe'l.   (ega TAKRORLANMAYDI)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She got up and answered the phone. He turned off the lights and went to bed.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U turdi va telefonga javob berdi. U chiroqlarni o'chirdi va yotdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ega BIR XIL bo'lsa, ikkinchi qismda tushirib qoldiriladi.
Bu — 'and' ning aniq belgisi.

sentencePatterns.formula: FIRST, ... , THEN ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: First, I went to the supermarket, then I went to the post office.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Avval supermarketga bordim, so'ng pochtaga bordim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'first' va 'then' — juft ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + fe'l + UP / DOWN / OVER / UNDER / INTO / THROUGH / ALONG / TOWARDS + joy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The firefighter climbed up the ladder. He is jumping over the hurdle.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O't o'chiruvchi narvondan yuqoriga chiqdi. U to'siq ustidan sakrayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Harakat predloglari yo'nalishni ANIQ ko'rsatadi.
Ko'pchiligining AKSI bor.

sentencePatterns.formula: WHO + O'TGAN fe'l + ...?   ('did' YO'Q — ega so'raladi)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Who drove to work? Who visited his grandparents?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kim ishga haydab bordi? Kim bobo-buvisiga bordi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Savol so'zi EGA bo'lsa, 'did' KERAK EMAS —
fe'l o'tgan shaklda qoladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: WHAT / WHERE + DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?   ('did' BOR)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What did Kate do? Where did they go?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Keyt nima qildi? Ular qayerga borishdi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Savol so'zi TO'LDIRUVChI yoki JOY bo'lsa, 'did' KERAK —
fe'l asosiy shaklda.

sentencePatterns.formula: DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?   →   ega + O'TGAN fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where did you go last night? — I went to Ann's party.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kecha kechqurun qayerga bording? — Annning ziyofatiga bordim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Savolda ASOSIY shakl, javobda O'TGAN shakl.
Bir dialogda bir xil fe'l ikki xil shaklda.

sentencePatterns.formula: Hozirgi holat + . I'LL + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's too hot. I'll open the window.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Juda issiq. Derazani ochaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'will' — AYNI DAMDA qabul qilingan qaror.
Hozirgi holatga javoban.

sentencePatterns.formula: WHEN + ega + o'tgan fe'l, + ega + o'tgan fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Yesterday, when she came home from work, she found a dog in the garden.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kecha ishdan uyga qaytganida bog'da it topdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'when' ikki o'tgan zamon voqeasini bog'laydi.
Gap boshida kelsa, o'rtaga VERGUL.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + o'tgan fe'l + ... + YESTERDAY / LAST ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We had dinner at my parents' house yesterday. Tom wrote three letters yesterday.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kecha ota-onamning uyida kechki ovqat yedik. Tom kecha uchta xat yozdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'yesterday', 'last ...' → PAST SIMPLE.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + AM/IS/ARE + fe'l-ING + RIGHT NOW / AT THE MOMENT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They are eating their breakfast right now. Tina is sleeping at the moment.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular hozir nonushta qilishyapti. Tina ayni damda uxlayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'right now', 'at the moment' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

sentencePatterns.formula: I think THERE WILL BE + ot + IN THE FUTURE.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I think there will be underwater cities in the future.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menimcha kelajakda suv ostidagi shaharlar bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'in the future' → WILL.
'I think ... will ...' — bashorat qolipi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Hozirgi holat + . I'LL / I WILL + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I will take my umbrella with me because it's raining.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Soyabonimni olib ketaman, chunki yomg'ir yog'yapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'will' — hozirgi holatga javoban AYNI DAMDA qabul
qilingan qaror.

sentencePatterns.formula: WHO did you + fe'l + ... WITH?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Who did you go out to dinner with?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kim bilan ovqatlanishga chiqding?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'with' gap OXIRIDA qoladi —
bu 'who' savolining aniq belgisi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Is this + ot + YOURS?   ↔   Is this YOUR + ot?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Excuse me, is this hat yours? / Is this your hat?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kechirasiz, bu shlyapa sizniki mi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'yours' — otsiz;  'your' — ot bilan.
Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri, lekin tuzilishi boshqa.
